body:
| Over the weekend, Nancy Mace—the ultimate spin doctor—launched a misleading attack against Annie.

We want to take a moment to talk about it, because not only is this an attack on Annie’s work, but an attack on the Lowcountry’s LGBTQ+ kids.

In the ad, Mace repeated false QAnon-based talking points against Annie. She accused Annie of pushing gender-changing hormones that she’s never actually been involved in, falsely claiming that this work is **child abuse.**

_None of Mace’s “facts” against trans youth are based on real information, but are instead from an old paper drafted by a medical student._

subject: This is our moment to make it happen
body:
| | | [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61424936:6zBjhMVNq:m:1:3253819041:C9442E3693FBCA76DA77EF41048FE4BE:r)
---
| | Peter, The establishment and political class have failed America.
They've failed Arizona. They are only concerned about their OWN power, so they refuse to address the real problems we face. That's why the problems just get worse. We're seeing that now with the border crisis, rising inflation, failing schools, and growing distrust in every American institution. Those on the inside can't fix what's broken. They ARE what's broken. That's why we need an outsider NOW who can get things done.** ** **[I AGREE >>](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61424936:6zBjhMVNq:m:1:3253819041:C9442E3693FBCA76DA77EF41048FE4BE:r)** _Just think about it ... Ronald Reagan didn't have political experience or government experience. President Donald Trump didn't either. We had great policies from these people._ I intend to bring policies to Arizona that are EQUALLY as great. I'm not coming into this game as a politician with a ruling class attitude. I'm taking on our real issues as a proud mom and as an American who is horrified by the action - and inaction - we're seeing in our government.
I think we're ready for another outsider to bring greatness to the people.**__** **_[Are you with me?](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61424936:6zBjhMVNq:m:1:3253819041:C9442E3693FBCA76DA77EF41048FE4BE:r) _**
---
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61424936:6zBjhMVNq:m:1:3253819041:C9442E3693FBCA76DA77EF41048FE4BE:r)
---
[**I 'M WITH KARI: SECURE THE BORDER >>**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61424936:6zBjhMVNq:m:1:3253819041:C9442E3693FBCA76DA77EF41048FE4BE:r)
---
**Peter, I promise you this, as the governor of Arizona, I will be the biggest pain in the ass Joe Biden 's ever experienced. ** I will unite with conservatives across the country to protect Arizona from this out-of-control federal government. We will save our states and return the power to WE, THE PEOPLE, where it belongs. **_This is our moment to make it happen. _**
---
Make no mistake... My opponent would be a NIGHTMARE to the pro-freedom, pro-America agenda we want to implement. Here's what you should know about Katie Hobbs. -> **_SHE WILL NOT DEFEND YOUR RIGHT TO BEAR ARMS!_** Katie has an F grade when it comes to protecting our Second Amendment rights. I don't know about you, but I feel that our Second Amendment is the most important amendment right now. _It 's the reason that we are still free. _ **_-> HER VOTING RECORD IS SHOCKING! _**She'll never talk about it, but 90% of the time when she was in our state legislature, she voted against small businesses. 90 percent! **_-> SHE FAILED TO SECURE OUR ELECTIONS._** Hobbs served as Secretary of State in 2020 in one of the most corrupt elections in American history. **_-> SHE IS A CONVICTED RACIST! _**Two separate juries unanimously convicted her of racial discrimination, and the taxpayers of Arizona are paying for her crimes! Almost $3 million as a payout for her court settlement because she did not pay Black employees the same as she paid white employees. _That is disgusting._
We cannot afford to let a radical lefty like Katie Hobbs turn Arizona into another California.**__**[**Will you help me defeat her?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61424936:6zBjhMVNq:m:1:3253819041:C9442E3693FBCA76DA77EF41048FE4BE:r)
---
Now, I don't care if you're with the Democrat Party, the Independent Party, the Republican Party, the Pizza Party, or the Pool Party - our policies are going to help every American. **_[We have to stand together and defeat the left so we can save America](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61424936:6zBjhMVNq:m:1:3253819041:C9442E3693FBCA76DA77EF41048FE4BE:r)_. ** I hope that you will chip in now to support my campaign for Governor of Arizona.**__**
---
[**SAVE AMERICA: SUPPORT KARI LAKE >>**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61424936:6zBjhMVNq:m:1:3253819041:C9442E3693FBCA76DA77EF41048FE4BE:r)
---
Sincerely,

**Kari Lake** _Candidate for Arizona Governor_

We are 3 days out from the FINAL quarter fundraising deadline before Election Day and our campaign is teetering on the edge... I’ve got to be able to get the truth out to the folks who are going to decide this election before his deceitful attack ads win the day. | [](http://links.alekskarlatosforcongress.com/u/click?_t=7e7d86e0b42141418fdbf0bb715c41e9&_m=116faac1e7244d1fb218ed06694d3d0e&_e=ALuDeML5u5D3l33hMNy-nj6QrJ-Xo6KXK5GqzpRMbDtQzbVc-CiyuPU_E-ZtFaePOC84F-aIhv2RrRkmdxZ8RA-FiAemATVoNZBmoVZzQ-Y8VH7VPSq3do9TvITuQ1FjNIz0J3nqUoAxMzv3odlxrSbo80k6JvGaLPPSEBmhdeGLx_tdvDUus0uLJcNDq9afs1jBRFPjixf_cD6_hMFh098F1mlxbtHw-b4ICU8H34gdyOTTV0OGiyJZHO2xDiI8rXPgeokQyIfaaOLc7eiXM2paZQey-yoEvZ3NSH7VQKiBzMEO9P0dEx1--Znn7XtKfNiYHjr2p-k2WxxuqCBa0ejZO1SRRUg-BJK2drJfhfBl5Nb6hW7ZXB3p-1_0hYPaekt8xgYoPdFFQ_1I4WCmfKPEELEO3C8dyAG9jyCosbk%3D)

Evening, Peter –

I just received a voicemail from my campaign manager who informs me that **we're running about $10,000 short of reaching our goal ($100,000 raised in September) that will unlock funding from the Republican National Committee.**

I'm including a screenshot of the voicemail below:

[](http://links.alekskarlatosforcongress.com/u/click?_t=7e7d86e0b42141418fdbf0bb715c41e9&_m=116faac1e7244d1fb218ed06694d3d0e&_e=ALuDeML5u5D3l33hMNy-nj6QrJ-Xo6KXK5GqzpRMbDtQzbVc-CiyuPU_E-ZtFaePOC84F-aIhv2RrRkmdxZ8RA-FiAemATVoNZBmoVZzQ-Y8VH7VPSq3do9TvITuQ1FjNIz0J3nqUoAxMzv3odlxrSbo80k6JvGaLPPSEBmhdeGLx_tdvDUus0uLJcNDq9afs1jBRFPjixf_cD6_hMFh098F1mlxbtHw-b4ICU8H34gdyOTTV0OGiyJZHO2xDiI8J_CzmcaBFdyg2AheSZjppl25q7ITc3EaaS7qVro5oOcge_5jwaajFaIEhhP1V6qt9KQe4zVjzOahPQG_iFQEOqVhlnIcMqACx7hp9TN9d_jNLw38xgvbDHfePBzIA3grah8Z9ablPzUXk9G8aQ9a_vy4GvnrDSqlgqCDzGRLpgE%3D)
Here is the crux of the matter: we are 3 days out from the FINAL quarter fundraising deadline before Election Day and our campaign is teetering on the edge...

[**CHIP IN $3 ➔**](http://links.alekskarlatosforcongress.com/u/click?_t=7e7d86e0b42141418fdbf0bb715c41e9&_m=116faac1e7244d1fb218ed06694d3d0e&_e=ALuDeML5u5D3l33hMNy-nj6QrJ-Xo6KXK5GqzpRMbDtQzbVc-CiyuPU_E-ZtFaePOC84F-aIhv2RrRkmdxZ8RA-FiAemATVoNZBmoVZzQ-Y8VH7VPSq3do9TvITuQ1FjNIz0J3nqUoAxMzv3odlxrSbo80k6JvGaLPPSEBmhdeGLx_tdvDUus0uLJcNDq9afs1jBRFPjixf_cD6_hMFh098F1mlxbtHw-b4ICU8H34gdyOTTV0OGiyJZHO2xDiI8cb6dMjmgr0GHlRuw-KiTMkf7GYddRZOl4lw_uUux2AyivArtpg_Q5zWb8xSEN8PvsMRSIaDIk86hilVDQ7-utP5RD1tlD6JGuXuFBQFXyjDWUBeQtaFrcoqi4YxavEyOTgQVMcdMga7qXB_K3SD0fnLrCXEhMlXuHUoIQmYFTvc%3D)

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

We need to elect more candidates who will take on corporate greed, authoritarianism, and bigotry and who are prepared to fight for justice. In solidarity,

Bernie Sanders

| | | Peter,

This is a longer email than usual but for the past months, I have become the #1 target of the Left, the liberal biased media, and Big Tech giants like Facebook, Twitter, and YouTube.

I have been smeared again and again by media companies like The New York Times, Washington Post, and the Milwaukee Journal Sentinel where they distort my comments, twist them through a liberal prism, and omit most of what I actually say.

I have been silenced, censored, and suspended by the social media oligarchs because I tell the truth, and oftentimes, it is the truth the liberal mainstream media does not want to hear. It counters their narrative, and they refuse to allow it. So they silence free speech.

Yet, despite all of this unconstitutional collusion between these far-Left parties working for political gain at the expense of the American people, I will not give up. They will not deter me.
And that is why I decided to run for re-election.

I am running for a third term for the simple reason that I believe I am the best person for the job. I believe that I am the best candidate to address the national debt, work to lower inflation, secure the border, and fight for America First policies. I believe I am the best candidate to put an end to the Biden administration's constant record of misinformation and their continued lack of transparency with Congress, the press, and you, Peter. Friend, Here’s the deal: tomorrow we’re facing our end of month deadline. We haven’t met our goals yet, and we need to raise at least $3,110 dollars more by the end of the night. **** **Let me give you some background about our finances.** **** When I announced my run for Governor, I made a pledge not to take any money from fossil fuel interests, pharmaceutical executives or any corporations. I decided to run for Governor because I wanted to stand up to powerful interests who work to undermine the needs of the people. Too many politicians side with big money because the powerful fund their campaigns. I don’t want any of that corrupting money. **** It’s a lot easier to just go to a few corporate donors for money, but that is just not who I am or what I believe in, so, we’re willing to do the hard work of building a campaign of the masses. **** I’m proud that we’ve built a grassroots movement of everyday Vermonters during this campaign. We’re creating a successful campaign of ordinary donors, not just the rich and powerful. **** Our fundraising numbers aren’t as high as we need them to be for this month. There’s less than a month until election day, and early voting has already started. To win, our campaign needs to send out mailers and buy TV ads ASAP. We don’t currently have enough money to do that. The Vermont GOP has used their deep-pocketed wealthy donors to gain a fundraising advantage, including a hefty contribution from a pharmaceutical company.[ ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953yx3cUQBGNTQ0X9M8L6qTDF03Wt1vGv5or9UTYmYhL9UwTaOK3HJfAISwwwoK4MiyyIr4scnw_PCyZqsC9AUgB9s1KVfPmdVCeGVxchDbTAk0k3iw_KUJjP89U2ie5F6GLiZ6xNhbdv6I-9aUGcmp7BawkBKwH672BkurMLvSvrn4NhuLrUNlcTQGaKs9N45ZRFK2cEtfPC1eti2PR1w3gQB-2GEF8PHd1tC_t29uYEaOejit9x8ab-uOhpTt2dxQJpez15LvzTzYPdJurFfAC6yO9pFKcmkO-v6HYhCsOG2TXq4ahaaeBitN5SO6k10uo/3pu/qU5SyStTQQCAjY4y3MtcoA/h0/Fq7Oh34KA4pz1UwmrmF4yyWsM61MRQRht_LuT2yD65E)[Without big money behind us, we need your help keeping pace. clean_body: | | Friend, Here’s the deal: tomorrow we’re facing our end of month deadline. We haven’t met our goals yet, and we need to raise at least $3,110 dollars more by the end of the night. ** Let me give you some background about our finances. When I announced my run for Governor, I made a pledge not to take any money from fossil fuel interests, pharmaceutical executives or any corporations. I decided to run for Governor because I wanted to stand up to powerful interests who work to undermine the needs of the people. Too many politicians side with big money because the powerful fund their campaigns. I don’t want any of that corrupting money. It’s a lot easier to just go to a few corporate donors for money, but that is just not who I am or what I believe in, so, we’re willing to do the hard work of building a campaign of the masses. I’m proud that we’ve built a grassroots movement of everyday Vermonters during this campaign. We’re creating a successful campaign of ordinary donors, not just the rich and powerful. ** Our fundraising numbers aren’t as high as we need them to be for this month. There’s less than a month until election day, and early voting has already started. To win, our campaign needs to send out mailers and buy TV ads ASAP. We don’t currently have enough money to do that. The Vermont GOP has used their deep-pocketed wealthy donors to gain a fundraising advantage, including a hefty contribution from a pharmaceutical company. We need to hit Friday’s goal. | | | Derek -- Under President Biden’s leadership, we’ve fought to restore the soul of this nation and unite the country. Democrats are fighting back to make sure that doesn’t happen, but we need your help. We need to hit Friday’s goal. Read President Biden’s message, and be one of the 21 more supporters we need from Manassas to chip in $7 ahead of our fundraising deadline. \-----Forwarded message----- Sender: President Joseph R. Biden, Jr. Date: Sat, September 24, 2022 Subject: You’ve yet to make a donation this year, and I need you to commit to our party. Chip in $7 to help elect Democrats nationwide. Derek, I believe with every fiber of my being that there’s not a thing in the world America can’t do if we set our mind to it. Since taking office, we’ve fought to restore the soul of this nation, restore the middle class, and unite the country. We put hundreds of millions of shots in arms, passed one of the single largest investments in infrastructure in American history, and put the first African American woman, Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson, on the Supreme Court. Every bit of progress we’ve made has been possible because of folks on this grassroots team. But if MAGA Republicans win this year, women could lose the right to choose anywhere in America. The right to contraception and marriage equality -- the whole right to privacy -- could be at risk. We can’t let that happen. And I don’t believe we will. You’ve yet to make a donation this year, and I need you to commit to our party. Chip in $7 to help elect Democrats nationwide in 2022. Make no mistake: Your contributions help elect Democratic senators, House members, and local officials. Hi Friend,
Under the Administrative Procedures Act, the Oregon Health Authority (OHA), Public Health Division has received a petition to repeal OAR 333-019-1030, COVID-19 Vaccination Requirements for Teachers and School Staff.

In accordance with state law, OHA is inviting public comment on the rules, including whether options exist for achieving the rule's substantive goals in a way that reduces the negative economic impact on businesses. OAR 137-001-0070(3).

body:
| |
---
| | | | [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61425172:6JPp7MVqN:m:1:3331421248:F3CAC5AA67D5189467CFBFF5FDB6C96A:r "It kills me to say this")
---
Peter, you know I hate to be negative.

There's truly no one who believes in this campaign more than me, which is why it kills me to say I may have to _**[call it quits.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61425172:6JPp7MVqN:m:1:3331421248:F3CAC5AA67D5189467CFBFF5FDB6C96A:r "call it quits.")**_

My finance team just sat me down and delivered some devastating news... _**we 're about to come up $4,750 short of our End-of-Quarter goal.**_
---
| | [HELP MEET TIFFANY'S GOAL](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61425172:6JPp7MVqN:m:1:3331421248:F3CAC5AA67D5189467CFBFF5FDB6C96A:r "HELP MEET TIFFANY’S GOAL")
---

Why is this such devastating news, you ask? Well, my opponent, Patty Murray, hit her goal DAYS ago and is already launching huge ad campaigns.

I'm genuinely overwhelmed by all of this. I don't see how we can catch up to an ever-growing and seemingly unbeatable war chest.

_**And to make matters worse, other Republican candidates are suffering the same fate and are closing up shop.**_

This couldn't be more severe and is why I'm asking - no begging - you to read every word of this email.

I'm a first-time candidate, veteran advocate, and political outsider. I've spent so much of my life raising my 3 incredible boys and caring for my husband when he was permanently blinded while serving in Iraq.

Unlike my opponent, I haven't spent the last 30 years building connections and raising money from political elites.

But that's precisely why I have a real chance of defeating her this November. I'm bringing the fresh ideas and leadership America needs, and the Democrats know it.

So I'll get right to it.

I need you on my team. I won't put a number on it because I mean it when I say anything you give can and will be a game-changer in this election.

We're creeping into the final hours of this quarter's deadline, but I know that we'll keep this campaign going with your support.

_**[So what do you think? Will you be a part of my history-making campaign by chipping in what you can before tonight's deadline?](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61425172:6JPp7MVqN:m:1:3331421248:F3CAC5AA67D5189467CFBFF5FDB6C96A:r "So what do you think? Will you be
a part of my history-making campaign by chipping in what you can before tonight’s deadline?")**_

I really hope you understand where I'm coming from.

I promise I wouldn't reach out like this if it weren't the end of the road.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

Hey, it's Tiffany Smiley.

The Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the COUNTRY!

Needless to say, all eyes are on us. We are in the FINAL DAYS until the November election, and Patty Murray is flooding millions into our state.

We are in an uphill battle, and I can't make it up to the top without you. Not just Washingtonians, but all Americans deserve a real leader with real solutions. Together, we can ensure that the American Dream is not lost.

_**[Rush support now to be a part of history](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61425173:6JPp7MVqN:m:1:3331421248:F3CAC5AA67D5189467CFBFF5FDB6C96A:r "Rush support now to be a part of

Tiffany Smiley

Team Smiley here with a RED ALERT!

You know we don't often beg, plead, or panic, but Tiffany is facing a key deadline, and we're OUT of time.

Whether or not you choose to act will decide the outcome of the Washington U.S. Senate Election:

Tiffany is currently being outraised and outspent by her 30-year incumbent opponent. We need all hands on deck to turn things around TODAY.

There's no time to wait on the sidelines.

_**[That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61425175:6JPp7MVqN:m:1:3331421248:F3CAC5AA67D5189467CFBFF5FDB6C96A:r "That's why we're HUMBLY asking for

* British Prime Minister, Boris Johnson...
* Canadian Prime Minister, Justin Trudeau...
* French President Emmanuel Macron...
* ... and many more...

From the stage, Yellen called for world leaders to commit to a $150 trillion 'global transition' of our economy. Investigative journalist and renowned economist, Nomi Prins has followed the money... She agreed to do the interview on one condition: she wanted to record it so she could get her message in front of as many Americans as possible before it's too late. [Go here to see how this ‘transformation’ will play out – and what it means for your money.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zqa2t5ev8o4t1f8rjfue0u356pji8kqsm5rvnk2g_rp22sh2s8i66or1cpim9oj6cth2bs) Regards, Maria Bonaventura

name: Tiffany Smiley
subject: Calling it quits
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Smiley for Washington, Inc
body:
It kills me to say this [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c920805%7c6019%7c7%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c0&wdmdk=h%2fg1VyMKoGHDiNDOTFK%2fgA&sysid=1)
It kills me to say this

| |
---
| | | | [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c86973%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=fdxv0edjpZYdXK7QIr4MbQ&sysid=1 "It kills me to say this")
---
Friend, you know I hate to be negative.

There’s truly no one who believes in this campaign more than me, which is why it kills me to say I may have to _**[call it quits.](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c86974%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=LY1%2bn0WHMLlH3z7ljfOlrA&sysid=1 "call it quits.")**_

My finance team just sat me down and delivered some devastating news... _**we’re about to come up $4,750 short of our End-of-Quarter goal.**_
---
| | [HELP MEET TIFFANY’S GOAL](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c86985%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=joIr5PxhwyTfuUR%2fL0B5OQ&sysid=1 "HELP MEET TIFFANY’S GOAL")
---

Why is this such devastating news, you ask? Well, my opponent, Patty Murray, hit her goal DAYS ago and is already launching huge ad campaigns.

I’m genuinely overwhelmed by all of this. I don’t see how we can catch up to an ever-growing and seemingly unbeatable war chest.

_**And to make matters worse, other Republican candidates are suffering the same fate and are closing up shop.**_

This couldn’t be more severe and is why I’m asking - no begging - you to read every word of this email.

I’m a first-time candidate, veteran advocate, and political outsider. I’ve spent so much of my life raising my 3 incredible boys and caring for my husband when he was permanently blinded while serving in Iraq.

Unlike my opponent, I haven’t spent the last 30 years building connections and raising money from political elites.

But that’s precisely why I have a real chance of defeating her this November. I’m bringing the fresh ideas and leadership America needs, and the Democrats know it.

So I’ll get right to it.

I need you on my team. I won’t put a number on it because I mean it when I say anything you give can and will be a game-changer in this election.

We’re creeping into the final hours of this quarter’s deadline, but I know that we’ll keep this campaign going with your support.

_**[So what do you think? Will you be a part of my history-making campaign by chipping in what you can before tonight’s deadline?](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c86986%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=ZK54FAcRvRH47VF8q%2bw1Rw&sysid=1 "So what do you think? Will you be a part of
my history-making campaign by chipping in what you can before tonight’s
deadline?")**_

I really hope you understand where I’m coming from.

I promise I wouldn’t reach out like this if it weren’t the end of the road.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| |

---
* * *
---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c86987%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=TvTKbIm%2bsYSoyQ%2fj6Ss%2blQ&sysid=1 "All Eyes On Washington")
---
Hey, it’s Tiffany Smiley.

The Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the COUNTRY!

Needless to say, all eyes are on us. We are in the FINAL DAYS until the November election, and Patty Murray is flooding millions into our state.

We are in an uphill battle, and I can’t make it up to the top without you. Not just Washingtonians, but all Americans deserve a real leader with real solutions. Together, we can ensure that the American Dream is not lost.

_**[Rush support now to be a part of history](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c86988%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=%2fTD2j9Z83cknq8m%2bzWrcqA&sysid=1 "Rush support now to be a part of
history")**_.

Let’s raise money and WIN,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| | | [JOIN TEAM SMILEY](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c86989%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=YFuPj3Nue9O82GZMKbRKDg&sysid=1 "JOIN TEAM SMILEY")
---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c86980%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=AcEO50Gwp5MEAVYybSHWMg&sysid=1 "Alert!")
---

Team Smiley here with a RED ALERT!

You know we don't often beg, plead, or panic, but Tiffany is facing a key deadline, and we're OUT of time.

Whether or not you choose to act will decide the outcome of the Washington U.S. Senate Election:

Tiffany is currently being outraised and outspent by her 30-year incumbent opponent. We need all hands on deck to turn things around TODAY.

There's no time to wait on the sidelines.

_**[That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c86981%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=b5g6OJkuxBDpgoFpqIY9bg&sysid=1 "That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help
in the next 15 minutes!")**_

This is our only chance to make history and restore a brighter future for Washington and all of America. We need Tiffany Smiley in the U.S. Senate, plain and simple.

Our team doesn't want to have to deliver bad news to Tiffany later today, so we're calling on our grassroots team, including YOU, to help increase our momentum!

Tiffany is a veterans' advocate and mother of 3! She is the new, fresh leadership we desperately need in Washington! Tiffany will be your #1 supporter in the U.S. Senate.

We're out of time. There's nowhere else to turn. Tiffany needs us at this moment. _**[Step up now!](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c86982%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=6NUrsbmBHEf%2bC1s1rH%2bQBA&sysid=1 "Step up now!")**_

My finance team just sat me down and delivered some devastating news... we’re about to come up $4,750 short of our End-of-Quarter goal. | | "HELP MEET TIFFANY’S GOAL" Why is this such devastating news, you ask? Well, my opponent, Patty Murray, hit her goal DAYS ago and is already launching huge ad campaigns. I’m genuinely overwhelmed by all of this. I don’t see how we can catch up to an ever-growing and seemingly unbeatable war chest. And to make matters worse, other Republican candidates are suffering the same fate and are closing up shop. This couldn’t be more severe and is why I’m asking - no begging - you to read every word of this email. I’m a first-time candidate, veteran advocate, and political outsider. I’ve spent so much of my life raising my 3 incredible boys and caring for my husband when he was permanently blinded while serving in Iraq. Unlike my opponent, I haven’t spent the last 30 years building connections and raising money from political elites. But that’s precisely why I have a real chance of defeating her this November. I’m bringing the fresh ideas and leadership America needs, and the Democrats know it. So I’ll get right to it. I need you on my team. I won’t put a number on it because I mean it when I say anything you give can and will be a game-changer in this election. We’re creeping into the final hours of this quarter’s deadline, but I know that we’ll keep this campaign going with your support. "So what do you think? Will you be a part of my history-making campaign by chipping in what you can before tonight’s deadline?" I really hope you understand where I’m coming from. I promise I wouldn’t reach out like this if it weren’t the end of the road. Sincerely, Tiffany Smiley | | | "All Eyes On Washington" Hey, it’s Tiffany Smiley. The Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the COUNTRY! Needless to say, all eyes are on us. We are in the FINAL DAYS until the November election, and Patty Murray is flooding millions into our state. We are in an uphill battle, and I can’t make it up to the top without you. Not just Washingtonians, but all Americans deserve a real leader with real solutions. Together, we can ensure that the American Dream is not lost. "Rush support now to be a part of history". Let’s raise money and WIN, Tiffany Smiley | | | "JOIN TEAM SMILEY" | "Alert!" Team Smiley here with a RED ALERT! You know we don't often beg, plead, or panic, but Tiffany is facing a key deadline, and we're OUT of time. Whether or not you choose to act will decide the outcome of the Washington U.S. Senate Election: Tiffany is currently being outraised and outspent by her 30-year incumbent opponent. We need all hands on deck to turn things around TODAY. There's no time to wait on the sidelines. "That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!" This is our only chance to make history and restore a brighter future for Washington and all of America. We need Tiffany Smiley in the U.S. Senate, plain and simple. Our team doesn't want to have to deliver bad news to Tiffany later today, so we're calling on our grassroots team, including YOU, to help increase our momentum! Tiffany is a veterans' advocate and mother of 3! She is the new, fresh leadership we desperately need in Washington! Tiffany will be your #1 supporter in the U.S. Senate. We're out of time. There's nowhere else to turn. Tiffany needs us at this moment. "Step up now!"** | | Paid for by Smiley for Washington, Inc. subject: This is our moment to make it happen
body:
| | | [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61427373:6pWIzMVNc:m:1:3331421248:D21DB0459373C706D2217B771A146A3E:r)
---
| | Peter, The establishment and political class have failed America.
They've failed Arizona. They are only concerned about their OWN power, so they refuse to address the real problems we face. That's why the problems just get worse. We're seeing that now with the border crisis, rising inflation, failing schools, and growing distrust in every American institution. Those on the inside can't fix what's broken. They ARE what's broken. That's why we need an outsider NOW who can get things done.** ** **[I AGREE >>](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61427373:6pWIzMVNc:m:1:3331421248:D21DB0459373C706D2217B771A146A3E:r)** _Just think about it ... Ronald Reagan didn't have political experience or government experience. President Donald Trump didn't either. We had great policies from these people._ I intend to bring policies to Arizona that are EQUALLY as great. I'm not coming into this game as a politician with a ruling class attitude. I'm taking on our real issues as a proud mom and as an American who is horrified by the action - and inaction - we're seeing in our government.
I think we're ready for another outsider to bring greatness to the people.**__** **_[Are you with me?](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61427373:6pWIzMVNc:m:1:3331421248:D21DB0459373C706D2217B771A146A3E:r) _**
---
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61427373:6pWIzMVNc:m:1:3331421248:D21DB0459373C706D2217B771A146A3E:r)
---
[**I 'M WITH KARI: SECURE THE BORDER >>**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61427373:6pWIzMVNc:m:1:3331421248:D21DB0459373C706D2217B771A146A3E:r)
---
**Peter, I promise you this, as the governor of Arizona, I will be the biggest pain in the ass Joe Biden 's ever experienced. ** I will unite with conservatives across the country to protect Arizona from this out-of-control federal government. We will save our states and return the power to WE, THE PEOPLE, where it belongs. **_This is our moment to make it happen. _**
---
Make no mistake... My opponent would be a NIGHTMARE to the pro-freedom, pro-America agenda we want to implement. Here's what you should know about Katie Hobbs. -> **_SHE WILL NOT DEFEND YOUR RIGHT TO BEAR ARMS!_** Katie has an F grade when it comes to protecting our Second Amendment rights. I don't know about you, but I feel that our Second Amendment is the most important amendment right now. _It 's the reason that we are still free. _ **_-> HER VOTING RECORD IS SHOCKING! _**She'll never talk about it, but 90% of the time when she was in our state legislature, she voted against small businesses. 90 percent! **_-> SHE FAILED TO SECURE OUR ELECTIONS._** Hobbs served as Secretary of State in 2020 in one of the most corrupt elections in American history. **_-> SHE IS A CONVICTED RACIST! _**Two separate juries unanimously convicted her of racial discrimination, and the taxpayers of Arizona are paying for her crimes! Almost $3 million as a payout for her court settlement because she did not pay Black employees the same as she paid white employees. _That is disgusting._
We cannot afford to let a radical lefty like Katie Hobbs turn Arizona into another California.**__**[**Will you help me defeat her?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61427373:6pWIzMVNc:m:1:3331421248:D21DB0459373C706D2217B771A146A3E:r)
---
Now, I don't care if you're with the Democrat Party, the Independent Party, the Republican Party, the Pizza Party, or the Pool Party - our policies are going to help every American. **_[We have to stand together and defeat the left so we can save America](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61427373:6pWIzMVNc:m:1:3331421248:D21DB0459373C706D2217B771A146A3E:r)_. ** I hope that you will chip in now to support my campaign for Governor of Arizona.**__**
---

---
Sincerely,

body:
We're getting dangerously close to the fundraising deadline that will determine the future of my race. The RNC in DC is watching my race closely; if my campaign can reach the goal they set for us, they'll invest in my district | [](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60839878:sqqUfPh4N:m:1:2237666910:175449614B7BC30F03D8FC9D1E7DD5C2:r)
---
Peter,

Time is flying by and we're getting dangerously close to the fundraising deadline that will determine the future of my race. The RNC in DC is watching my race closely; **if my campaign can reach the goal they set for us, they'll invest in my district.**

Today marks 41 days until Election Day and 2 days until the end of the 3rd quarter, meaning that as of this writing, **[I've only 2 days to meet their goal, or it's sayonara.](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60839878:sqqUfPh4N:m:1:2237666910:175449614B7BC30F03D8FC9D1E7DD5C2:r)** In case you missed it , I'm forwarding my original message from last week.

**[I'd be so appreciative if you were able to gift my campaign a couple dollars to help us reach this make-or-break fundraising goal](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60839878:sqqUfPh4N:m:1:2237666910:175449614B7BC30F03D8FC9D1E7DD5C2:r)**.

| [**GIFT A COUPLE BUCKS** **› › **](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60839878:sqqUfPh4N:m:1:2237666910:175449614B7BC30F03D8FC9D1E7DD5C2:r)
---

\-----Forwarded message-----
From: Alek Skarlatos - info@alekskarlatosforcongress.com
Date: Fri Sept 16 2022
Subject: I've been given an ultimatum
To: {{email}}

{{#if [FirstName]}}{{[FirstName]}}{{else}}Fellow Conservative{{/if}},

They just keep moving the ball on me; I feel like I can't get a break, and to be honest with you it's exhausting. The Republican Party big-wigs in D.C. keep hedging their bets and won't commit to sending me help because they're somehow still not sure that I'm worth the investment.

Instead of putting money into my race, they're spending millions on seats we can't win. But, as a former national guardsman, I know how to play by the rules and take orders; here is hoping you can help me meet the requirements they've set in order to barnstorm the state with money to help me secure victory.

**National Republicans want me to raise $100,000 by the end of the quarter (September 30th), and they'll make an investment in my race; if i can't, I'll be on my own till the end.**

With only 14 days to go, we're still short about $60,000. **[If you're in a position to give, would you make a generous contribution to my campaign today?](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60839878:sqqUfPh4N:m:1:2237666910:175449614B7BC30F03D8FC9D1E7DD5C2:r)**

[**GIFT A COUPLE BUCKS** **› › **](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60839878:sqqUfPh4N:m:1:2237666910:175449614B7BC30F03D8FC9D1E7DD5C2:r)
---

Whether it's a test or not - I'm not taking any chances. While Oregon's 4th district has been held by the same career politician since 1986, it's ripe for the picking now that he is finally retiring.
**
[If you're on the fence about donating to my campaign, remember this race has national implications. The outcome of my race could well determine which party controls the House next year. ](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60839878:sqqUfPh4N:m:1:2237666910:175449614B7BC30F03D8FC9D1E7DD5C2:r) **

My opponent this year is a the protegée of my opponent from 2020, meaning she supports the Green New Deal, and would most certainly join the House Progressive Caucus.

Republicans came within 554 votes in 2016 from flipping OR-4 from BLUE to RED. Please help me finish the job this time around. If I'm able to secure a sizeable investment from Republicans in D.C., I know we can overcome the barriers that kept us from winning this race two years ago.

[**GIFT A COUPLE BUCKS** **› › **](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60839878:sqqUfPh4N:m:1:2237666910:175449614B7BC30F03D8FC9D1E7DD5C2:r)
---

I know that you have a lot of political candidates asking for you to make contributions to their campaign, but I'd like you to ask yourself this: how many races could realistically determine whether or not Nancy Pelosi loses the speaker's gavel next Congress? Less than 10.

[**GIFT A COUPLE BUCKS** **› › **](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60839878:sqqUfPh4N:m:1:2237666910:175449614B7BC30F03D8FC9D1E7DD5C2:r)

Thanks for your consideration, {{#if [FirstName]}}{{[FirstName]}}{{else}}Fellow Conservative{{/if}}

subject: we hear a lot about “outsiders”
body:
| | | [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61427318:6k73BMVVN:m:1:3253819041:E195A6A85BE7BE1BB246C8516CD8FBA1:r)
---
| | Peter, The establishment and political class have failed America.
They've failed Arizona. They are only concerned about their OWN power, so they refuse to address the real problems we face. That's why the problems just get worse. We're seeing that now with the border crisis, rising inflation, failing schools, and growing distrust in every American institution. Those on the inside can't fix what's broken. They ARE what's broken. That's why we need an outsider NOW who can get things done.** ** **[I AGREE >>](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61427318:6k73BMVVN:m:1:3253819041:E195A6A85BE7BE1BB246C8516CD8FBA1:r)** _Just think about it ... Ronald Reagan didn't have political experience or government experience. President Donald Trump didn't either. We had great policies from these people._ I intend to bring policies to Arizona that are EQUALLY as great. I'm not coming into this game as a politician with a ruling class attitude. I'm taking on our real issues as a proud mom and as an American who is horrified by the action - and inaction - we're seeing in our government.
I think we're ready for another outsider to bring greatness to the people.**__** **_[Are you with me?](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61427318:6k73BMVVN:m:1:3253819041:E195A6A85BE7BE1BB246C8516CD8FBA1:r) _**
---
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61427318:6k73BMVVN:m:1:3253819041:E195A6A85BE7BE1BB246C8516CD8FBA1:r)
---
[**I 'M WITH KARI: SECURE THE BORDER >>**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61427318:6k73BMVVN:m:1:3253819041:E195A6A85BE7BE1BB246C8516CD8FBA1:r)
---
**Peter, I promise you this, as the governor of Arizona, I will be the biggest pain in the ass Joe Biden 's ever experienced. ** I will unite with conservatives across the country to protect Arizona from this out-of-control federal government. We will save our states and return the power to WE, THE PEOPLE, where it belongs. **_This is our moment to make it happen. _**
---
Make no mistake... My opponent would be a NIGHTMARE to the pro-freedom, pro-America agenda we want to implement. Here's what you should know about Katie Hobbs. -> **_SHE WILL NOT DEFEND YOUR RIGHT TO BEAR ARMS!_** Katie has an F grade when it comes to protecting our Second Amendment rights. I don't know about you, but I feel that our Second Amendment is the most important amendment right now. _It 's the reason that we are still free. _ **_-> HER VOTING RECORD IS SHOCKING! _**She'll never talk about it, but 90% of the time when she was in our state legislature, she voted against small businesses. 90 percent! **_-> SHE FAILED TO SECURE OUR ELECTIONS._** Hobbs served as Secretary of State in 2020 in one of the most corrupt elections in American history. **_-> SHE IS A CONVICTED RACIST! _**Two separate juries unanimously convicted her of racial discrimination, and the taxpayers of Arizona are paying for her crimes! Almost $3 million as a payout for her court settlement because she did not pay Black employees the same as she paid white employees. _That is disgusting._
We cannot afford to let a radical lefty like Katie Hobbs turn Arizona into another California.**__**[**Will you help me defeat her?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61427318:6k73BMVVN:m:1:3253819041:E195A6A85BE7BE1BB246C8516CD8FBA1:r)
---
Now, I don't care if you're with the Democrat Party, the Independent Party, the Republican Party, the Pizza Party, or the Pool Party - our policies are going to help every American. **_[We have to stand together and defeat the left so we can save America](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61427318:6k73BMVVN:m:1:3253819041:E195A6A85BE7BE1BB246C8516CD8FBA1:r)_. ** I hope that you will chip in now to support my campaign for Governor of Arizona.**__**

Friend –
I’ll be honest with you. I never thought this is how it’d go.
When Gabby and I got married, I never thought this is the way things would turn out.
I never thought I’d run for public office. She was the elected official in the family, and on the International Space Station, I was about as far from Congress as you can get.
I never thought more than 1 million people would contribute and volunteer to help elect me.

body:

This is a longer email than usual but for the past months, I have become the #1 target of the Left, the liberal biased media, and Big Tech giants like Facebook, Twitter, and YouTube.

_This is a longer, personal note from Marcy. We hope you’ll take a moment to read it from beginning to end and hear why this community and this fight mean so much to Marcy. If you don’t have time,**[please consider clicking here to make a contribution of $5 ahead of our end-of-quarter deadline, and help keep Marcy fighting for Northern Ohio families.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51505147/369511230/-340415969?refcode=EM_FR_220928FRAM_N_MK_45SA_9_NG_N_L1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTY1NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNjhhZjRhMS0zMjNmLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgzMmU0Y2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-swPGaCDdYbXiLNJS4J5HnqNF7XdTtzCCcShx3YN6hg=)**_ Friend,

I want to talk to you about my house. Not the House of Representatives, but my childhood home in Toledo, where I still reside today.

Where I come from, a house still means a lot. It represents family and the stake we hold in our community. My grandparents were Polish immigrants choosing to lay down roots and raise their families in Toledo. They instilled diligence and duty into my parents - mom worked in a spark plug factory where she served on the UAW organizing committee, and dad ran a small family grocery store.

I got my first lesson in economic injustice as a child when a meat supplier refused to sell my father high-quality beef for his store. I witnessed my father fight for the right of his working-class customers to have the same quality products as everyone else, and the supplier relented. At that moment, my path was laid out.

As the house was passed down, so too were the values of hard work and community service. Because my parents invested in me, I was the first person in my family to go to college. I worked in urban planning and development, but when my community asked me to step up and run for Congress, I answered the call.

I tell this story to illustrate the point that this district **_deserves_** a representative in Congress who understands its unique needs. I have lived in this district, in the same house, for most of my life. My constituents are friends and neighbors, and I have been honored to serve them and fight for them.

Governing is not always glamorous. Crafting, amending, and passing legislation is a grueling process that requires the dedication and patience that my parents instilled in me. It involves identifying the needs of a community and then fighting hard to bring back the resources needed to help the region thrive.

From funding for job training in our schools or constructing the World War II Memorial to securing funding for a vegetable garden at a senior housing complex and holding back the Asian carp’s invasion of the Great Lakes, no project can be too daunting.

I love this district like I love my house. My work is both challenging and fulfilling. It is the highest honor of my life to serve our community. I will always put forth my very best effort for the people of Northern Ohio because they deserve nothing less.

**[This November, though, I face a tough battle to keep serving my community in Congress. The GOP is throwing everything they have at me, and I need your help. I strive to serve others by leading with love, and I know that Gabe Vasquez will do the same thing for the people of New Mexico’s 2nd district if elected to Congress. Gabe loves New Mexico and wants to give his community the leadership they deserve in Washington. This November, Gabe is running up against a far-right extremist and election-denying incumbent, and **with Republicans _just five seats away_ from flipping the House, this is a must-win race to defend our majority and stop the MAGA movement.** With MAGA Republicans like Gabe’s opponent threatening to pass a nationwide abortion ban, impeach President Biden, and suppress our basic right to vote, we cannot afford to sit on the sidelines in this year’s midterm elections. Gabe will be a true representative of the people who stands up for a woman’s right to choose, our free and fair elections, action on climate change, and economic opportunity for all. Friend, listen up: With the election approaching quickly, I'm gonna make this real short and sweet.

Maggie Hassan's GOP opponent is officially Don Bolduc. He'll be a rubber stamp for Mitch McConnell's backwards, disastrous, anti-choice agenda, and he'll help enact a national abortion ban the first chance he gets.

body:
I decided to run for the U.S. Senate in 2010 because growing entitlements and out-of-control federal spending had exploded our national debt to $14 trillion.
|
---
| | | Peter,

I decided to run for the U.S. Senate in 2010 because growing entitlements and out-of-control federal spending had exploded our national debt to $14 trillion. We were on an unsustainable path that was mortgaging our children's future.

Fortunately, Americans decided that a government controlled by liberal Democrats wasn't good for the country, and they elected Republicans to the House to halt President Obama's extreme policies. A Republican majority in the Senate followed in 2014.

As I ran for re-election in 2016, we had the prospect of electing a Republican president who could work with a Republican Congress not only to stop the expansion of liberal policies but, we hoped, to reverse some of the damage done during Mr. Obama's administration. I figured we had an opportunity to put America back on the right path, and I was more than willing to dedicate myself to that worthy effort.

By and large, Republican policies worked. Regulatory relief and a more competitive tax system helped create a healthy economy with low inflation and record low unemployment. Strengthening the military deterred our enemies, and policies designed to secure the borders dramatically reduced the flow of illegal immigration.

During the 2016 campaign, I said it would be my last campaign and final term. That was my strong preference, and my wife's--we both looked forward to a normal private life. However, neither of us anticipated the Democrats' complete takeover of government and the disastrous policies they have already inflicted on America and the world, to say nothing of those they threaten to enact in the future.

Nor did we anticipate the pandemic, the government's failed response to it, the loss of freedom that has resulted, and the tyrannical approach taken by the elites who have created and maintained a state of fear that allows them to exercise control over Americans' lives. Instead of everyone working to achieve the goal President Biden stated during his inaugural address--unifying and healing America--it feels as if our nation is being torn apart.

As I travel around Wisconsin and talk to citizens who love our country, I know I am not the only one with grave concerns. My message has always been that America is precious, and it is our solemn duty to make sure it survives and thrives for future generations.

President Reagan warned that freedom is fragile, always one generation away from extinction. As I have told crowds since my first Tea Party speeches in 2010: This is a fight for freedom. This is not someone else's fight, this is our fight, and it's a fight we absolutely must win.

I believe America is in peril. Much as I'd like to ease into a quiet retirement, I don't feel I should. Countless people have encouraged me to run, saying they rely on me to be their voice, to speak plain and obvious truths other elected leaders shirk from expressing--truths the elite in government, mainstream media, and Big Tech don't want you to hear.

In 2010 I promised I would always tell people the truth and that I would never vote with re-election in mind. When re-election isn't your primary motivation, those are easy promises to keep. Today, I am announcing I will continue to fight for freedom in the public realm by running for re-election. It is a decision I haven't made lightly. Having already experienced a growing level of vitriol and false attacks, I certainly don't expect better treatment in the future. For my campaign to succeed, I will need the support of every American who values the truth and refuses to allow lies and distortions to prevail.

Tens of millions of dollars will be spent trying to destroy and defeat me. The mainstream media and Big Tech will contribute their powerful and corrupt voices as the unofficial but reliable communication apparatus of the Democrats. We face powerful forces that desire even more power and control over our lives. Their path, paved with false hope and greater dependency, always leads to tyranny. We cannot let them win.

So I will humbly ask for your endorsement to help me SAVE AMERICA.
---

Ron Johnson

We need to be clear about what’s on the ballot this year because there’s a heck of a lot at stake. | | Derek, we’re just 41 days from the midterm elections. We need to be clear about what’s on the ballot this year because there’s a heck of a lot at stake. Gun safety for our kids is on the ballot. Social Security and Medicare are on the ballot. The survival of our planet and democracy itself are on the ballot. That’s why if you’ve been waiting on the sidelines to donate, now’s your chance. It’d mean a lot to me personally if you chipped in $7 today, Derek. Let’s take a look at what Republican Kevin McCarthy said: He said Republicans want to “preserve our constitutional freedoms.” That sounds great. I’m for doing that as well. But look at what they’ve actually done. The MAGA Republicans cheered for the Supreme Court’s decision to take away the constitutional right to choose. And now, nearly half the states in the United States of America have either enacted a ban on abortion or are expected to shortly. In many states, abortion is already banned even in cases of rape and incest. Leader Kevin McCarthy talked about wanting a nation that’s safe. Well, let’s look at what Republicans have done to make it safe. They voted against virtually everything we’ve done to reduce crime and keep communities safe. The American Rescue Plan delivered resources to local leaders to keep their schools, hospitals, fire and police departments open. And guess what? Every single Republican in the Congress voted against it. This November, you have to choose. Will we be a nation of hope and unity and optimism? Or a nation of fear and division and darkness? I know the American people. I know your courage. I know your hearts. I know our history. That’s why I’ve never been more optimistic. Thanks, Joe Joseph R. Hi Peter,

Here’s the problem – the numbers aren’t adding up. We have a strong plan to reach voters across the 5th Congressional district through a variety of methods but unfortunately we have a $45,000 budget gap between our fundraising projections and the budget. Right now it looks like we might have to slash a chunk out of our targeted digital ads budget if we don’t find a way to make up lost ground.
We can’t lose this race. As a mother, I’m terrified about the Tennessee my daughter is growing up in. We need Senator Campbell in Congress so we can codify Roe v. Wade and fully fund our public schools.
We’re trying our best to raise the money needed to win this race and we can’t fall short. Can you help us make up this gap in our budget before Friday’s end of quarter fundraising deadline? Beth Joslin Roth

Hi, Peter, it's Trudy. I know most people think you have to be out of your mind to run for office – and maybe they're not wrong to think that.
The campaign trail is all-consuming. I can't count the hours I've logged on the road this week alone – not to mention all the nights I've spent away from home these past few months. Campaigning quickly becomes your entire life. It reminds me all too much of my early days in nursing school. **But there's one thing that has always kept me energized – both on the campaign trail and in school – and that's listening.**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51513969/369546347/-1746441832?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk314-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2M2NhYzhlYy0zZTNmLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgzMmU0Y2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=udNP2ukeRyqwphSGxB7S7GzUaEvV6maSJkuA1VHNp1Y=)
Being a good listener might not be the flashiest skill – but I believe it's one of the most valuable. The ability to truly listen to my patients is what made me an empathetic nurse. It made me a caring and helpful advocate for the vulnerable children I advocated for. It made me a nurturing mother. It strengthened my marriages. **And now, it's what will make me the effective, compassionate Senator that Missourians deserve.**
Today, far too many politicians in Washington are wildly out of touch with their constituents – and it's because they've forgotten how to listen (or in some cases, they never learned). **Families back home need leaders who know when it's time to stop lecturing and start listening. They need senators who will work together as a team and meaningfully show up to hear what their constituents have to say.**
While I have been running for office, I have done all that I can to visit every corner of my state and hear what is on people's minds. I've listened to thousands of stories about what's going wrong in our country and across our state and what it'll take to get things back on track. Now, it's time to head to Washington so that we can do something about it.
**So please, I need your help to win in November. Our public end-of-quarter deadline is tomorrow, and we're still short of our goal. body:
My First Time... Jacob's Ladder... I have read the story time and time again but I have never preached a sermon on it until this last Sunday at Sher
| | |
---
## My First Time...
---
| [ ](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14529129.8472.1.fb8941b17979dbcd995d3bcf9f641ff7)
---
[Jacob's Ladder](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14529129.8473.1.80ac2d5903e8b5afe4651f4fb3bcd81a)...
I have read the story time and time again but **I have never preached a sermon on it** until this last Sunday at [Sheridan.Church](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14529129.8474.1.2e8c78f10648c2142c9094fc0ea72f54).
All I can say is WOW!
There is so much _richness_ in the story of [Jacob's Ladder](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14529129.8475.1.85fbd6260089fcc902210745db9bd488), especially in regards to God's Divine Council (angels, demons & Satan).
I have provided a link that you can follow to watch the message and I know you will be blessed!
Watch Genesis Pt. 30 - [Jacob's Ladder](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14529129.8476.1.53e7cdb1202f86fdf6ef3cc26fdec70d) here: https://youtu.be/dKjLCY3lw-0
Also, I have started a new series on Wednesday nights at [Sheridan.Church](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14529129.8477.1.583dcb9c979633b05b52b78df3998b97) over the **Book of Revelation**.
| [ ](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14529129.8478.1.1233e784869032109e3a6ea1682579f8)
---
We are taking our time through the **Book of Revelation** by going verse by verse.
Watch Pt. 1 here: [https://youtu.be/oPfmX_Aus-M?t=2](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14529129.8479.1.aa79fcbedf786316d980ceefc7464d57)
---
## HUGE News!
---
| [ ](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14529129.8480.1.0087acd031cf7771f5b0ee753f88a3cf)
---
It's the _honor of my life_ to be the Pastor of [Sheridan.Church](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14529129.8481.1.719e2bbce64bf01d0c9fb61832800183) in Tulsa, OK.
God has blessed our church with **tremendous growth**.
Last year, we launched a second Sunday service to make room for the growth.
Currently, we have services every Sunday at 9 & 11 am as well as Wednesday at 7pm.
**Our current location has been amazing, but we are outgrowing it.**
On Sundays at 11 am, I will find myself in the church lobby watching cars circle our parking lot trying to find a place to park because we have run out of parking before the service even begins and as a Pastor that's a horrible thing to see because your heart's desire is to reach people.
Last year, we began seeking the Lord for _direction_ on addressing this good problem.
God has poured out His favor on [Sheridan.Church](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14529129.8482.1.6ab9512a4ad3d8462de6d72cddbb6818)!
We have **acquired 6 acres in South Tulsa** between 81st and 91st off of Memorial.

name: Will Rollins
subject: It’s my birthday.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Will Rollins for Congress
body:
Peter,

I wanted to take a moment to **thank you** for all the birthday wishes (and donations)! So many of you have chipped in, and with our huge end-of-quarter deadline coming up on Friday, that was truly the best gift you could have given. Especially to a person who has to fundraise on their own birthday.

I started this journey with a straightforward mission: Make our government function better for working families in CA-41 and across the country. We are facing serious and complex challenges as a nation, and we can't waste time on political bickering -- nor can we accept attacks on our democracy from _within_ our own halls of Congress.

The outpouring of support we’ve seen has been so humbling. Not only does it prove that thousands upon thousands of grassroots donors believe in our mission, but it’s also giving our entire campaign team the fire and motivation we need to win this race. **When we say we can’t do this without you, we truly mean it.**

We are now two days away from our final FEC deadline before Election Day. We’re hoping to send an overwhelming message of grassroots strength that even Ken Calvert can’t ignore. clean_body: Just last month, we passed the Inflation Reduction Act to lower energy costs, health care costs, and prescription drug costs. | | Derek, there are 41 days to go until this November’s election. 41 days. We have to make every one of these days count because this election will determine the future of our country. This year, the stakes could not be higher. Now, I know we say that every election cycle, but what is at stake this year in these midterms is so apparent -- everything from voting rights to abortion is on the ballot. If we defend the seats we need to hold on to our majority in the House and we protect --or better yet, expand \-- our majority in the Senate, we can continue our progress. You haven’t made a donation yet this year. Can I count on you to make your first gift of the year before the DNC’s Friday end-of-quarter deadline? Just last month, we passed the Inflation Reduction Act to lower energy costs, health care costs, and prescription drug costs. Democrats have proven that when the people put our party in charge, we know how to deliver results. From now until November 8, it is up to all of us to build on our momentum, including you. Ensuring the DNC meets its end-of-quarter deadline is critical to getting Democrats up and down the ballot across the finish line, so I’m asking: Thank you for doing what you can to support Democrats, Derek. body:
In the motorcade up Pennsylvania Avenue, the Vice President told me that our country always rejects extreme views in the end...
#

Friends -
I will never forget the day I sat in then-Vice President Joe Biden's ceremonial office in the Capitol as I watched the United States Senate block a bipartisan bill to close the loopholes that let people buy guns without a background check.
Shortly after the vote ended, the Vice President told me it was "a despicable day in the Senate," and invited me to join him and President Obama at the White House.
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-sept22.KOv07R&refcode=em220928-1-30&t=1&akid=2530%2E3935704%2Ea4Bv53)
In the motorcade up Pennsylvania Avenue, the Vice President told me that our country always rejects extreme views in the end. He said that commonsense gun safety legislation would pass eventually—that it was not a question of if, but when.
Nine years later, he signed the most significant piece of federal gun safety legislation in almost three decades. It’s lifesaving progress that you helped achieve.
But our work is not done.
We have a president in the White House who will sign lifesaving gun safety legislation.
Our job is to elect a Congress with the votes to get it to him, but I cannot do that alone.
[**Can you please make a contribution to Giffords PAC before the FEC fundraising deadline comes to an end in just a few days? We will use your donation to elect a Congress that will act to make our communities safer from gun violence.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-sept22.KOv07R&refcode=em220928-1-30&t=2&akid=2530%2E3935704%2Ea4Bv53)

Let’s discuss the issues in Concord!

View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/votetylerlee/congresswoman-adams-lawless-behavior-7342713?e=4ed8243e91)
https://secure.anedot.com/b5c81bee-6e5f-4118-91cb-3dab5c3f0037/oct-4th?utm_source=Tyler+Lee+for+Congress&utm_campaign=17580fc6d0-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2022_07_19_10_56_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_ac8d25e432-17580fc6d0-617881201
Fellow Patriot,
Engaged citizens keep our Constitutional Republic alive by working together as a constituency, speaking up on the issues, and seeking out leaders who will represent citizens accordingly!

That’s why I’m excited to be out on the campaign trail taking the opportunity to hear how North Carolinians would like their leaders to represent them at this pivotal time in our nation’s history!

I’m grateful to Beth Blevins, who is graciously hosting the Meet & Greet in Concord on Oct. 4th, and I hope you’ll be able to join us!

RSVP today by emailing nathan@votetylerlee.com (mailto:nathan@votetylerlee.com) .
The event will be held at 1114 Berkeley Place in Concord on Tuesday, October 4th beginning at 6:00 pm.

I hope you’ll be able to join us for some robust discourse as we consider how we must act together to address the pressing issues of inflation, surging crime, and our educational crisis that we must face before it’s too late!

Don’t forget to RSVP today if you haven’t yet by emailing nathan@votetylerlee.com (mailto:nathan@votetylerlee.com) .

If you are unable to attend but would like to support our campaign, please do so here (https://secure.anedot.com/b5c81bee-6e5f-4118-91cb-3dab5c3f0037/oct-4th?utm_source=Tyler+Lee+for+Congress&utm_campaign=17580fc6d0-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2022_07_19_10_56_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_ac8d25e432-17580fc6d0-617881201) :

##### John Philip Sousa IV
###### National Chairman of Stars & Stripes Forever PAC
###### _Formerly the 2016 Committee and National Draft Ben Carson for President Committee_

Without a doubt, the outcome of this election will determine the direction our country heads for the next two years. Will the Socialists have a clear path for passing more legislation increasing the cost and size of government, taking away more of our constitutional freedoms and destroying our economy and international standing among our Allies? Or will we elect more America First men and women and send many of those Liberals home? I want that direction to be the road blocking of President Biden's and the Democrats' socialist agenda during the 2nd half of Biden's presidency. Economic experts predict that in addition to a weaker economy, Americans across all income groups will face higher taxes in the next two years. In fact, just with the passage of the Inflation Reduction Act, taxpayers in every single income category (from $10,000 on up) will pay higher taxes... That's why we must fight to stop him! Frankly, we don't have the financial resources that the national parties do, but we do have our successful _**Nadler Method and you**_ in our arsenal. So while the parties are fighting to win contests around the nation, we have identified three key Senate races and six congressional seats where lifting the Black and Latino vote for Republicans can secure victories and give us more leverage in blocking the Democrats oppressive agenda during the 2nd half of Biden's presidency. Peter,

Unlike most of these professional politicians, I didn’t have a privileged leg up or a family member that could make some introductions for me to get to where I am today.

So let me introduce myself – **[my name is April Becker and I’m running for Congress.](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=a117d5c78c77425e962de2cfac3089f0&_e=Ed79LOm3DVysDwpoAHdHUEaTNrPIwUkdHRQOXUwlwL2caBAhn8POwl5jNznJ9VJ7PZMKK_minVNevXGYivBPqaHWj9Ng1JlmmYspJCmQyPssuz5zdoaal1pFnJhzeKRUoDR9KOfL01mp_IygAk2piS7F0vmDf6c4vPqnclGhddqo9uMqjG509aZbxlDHNE8pW0AJLkWW7dAvKQxmvLERG3CTc4E-C1PQRvZ5OSio7DwQTdC5JqHzYNtYKxJqwMGrXRRNcPVQSdbkpUnRP8ULv0F8xO50MYmEd_IMmn3UDmLEAFidWuD40JCw0cWYNvHKN9K8sS4JxmUJJQUB5p2R-Iacc91S1jDU9spjdbEcmDIx1clHfYr73mEQWgP2bSyH_4SXe4itlV3bKS8qf9xeq06GSf4WdqRfZ9b5l2KAu_U%3D)**

**I started as a single mom, working as a waitress and bartender. Every penny that didn’t go towards providing a stable life for my children went towards college classes, which I took when I could.**

[](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=a117d5c78c77425e962de2cfac3089f0&_e=Ed79LOm3DVysDwpoAHdHUEaTNrPIwUkdHRQOXUwlwL2caBAhn8POwl5jNznJ9VJ7PZMKK_minVNevXGYivBPqaHWj9Ng1JlmmYspJCmQyPssuz5zdoaal1pFnJhzeKRUoDR9KOfL01mp_IygAk2piS7F0vmDf6c4vPqnclGhddqo9uMqjG509aZbxlDHNE8pW0AJLkWW7dAvKQxmvLERG3CTc4E-C1PQRvZ5OSio7DwQTdC5JqHzYNtYKxJqwMGrXRRNcPVQSdbkpUnRP8ULv2sDmdJK14UyGlZFYQJrijwxztjC2MMLHSgQ4FV_vFbs41FEiFfOdAgVDWqKqtcHNbNY9J6ffzLKvxT7URTlwHxFa-3kjhLZTRC-zoNoJdMzQza8NYQGX2eaEgq0lAcgUZJOBBzyhuBVcWMO-1PUcHk%3D)
At age 39, I graduated law school. I won’t lie and paint some idealistic picture; **it was a struggle to get there, but it was all so worth it.** The type of experience you gain in life by pulling yourself up by your bootstraps is something that can’t be bought or taught at the country club.

That’s what this campaign is about. It’s about representing the average American. It’s about the mom with three kids trying to balance a full-time job and soccer practice. It’s about the blue-collar worker saving for their child’s college fund.

**It’s about you – and that’s why[I need your help.](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=a117d5c78c77425e962de2cfac3089f0&_e=Ed79LOm3DVysDwpoAHdHUEaTNrPIwUkdHRQOXUwlwL2caBAhn8POwl5jNznJ9VJ7PZMKK_minVNevXGYivBPqaHWj9Ng1JlmmYspJCmQyPssuz5zdoaal1pFnJhzeKRUoDR9KOfL01mp_IygAk2piS7F0vmDf6c4vPqnclGhddqo9uMqjG509aZbxlDHNE8pW0AJLkWW7dAvKQxmvLERG3CTc4E-C1PQRvZ5OSio7DwQTdC5JqHzYNtYKxJqwMGrXRRNcPVQSdbkpUnRP8ULv1EEUKTa8AWiWG5WCNBWT25bystopHa564qtwYjxS5XKwZJdT6ZyjK4uyoBYyMuWG5VjlU266Pl4wC8qwE3OPVzlW7lbNosOLtzJdbCSp_1sxZFmzk0Zh6I0APBP6dnvk3bB5HWjBrJZi9zNgNYJj8A%3D)**

As someone that built my American Dream from the ground up, **[_I know in my heart that anything is possible, especially with the right people behind me._](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=a117d5c78c77425e962de2cfac3089f0&_e=Ed79LOm3DVysDwpoAHdHUEaTNrPIwUkdHRQOXUwlwL2caBAhn8POwl5jNznJ9VJ7PZMKK_minVNevXGYivBPqaHWj9Ng1JlmmYspJCmQyPssuz5zdoaal1pFnJhzeKRUoDR9KOfL01mp_IygAk2piS7F0vmDf6c4vPqnclGhddqo9uMqjG509aZbxlDHNE8pW0AJLkWW7dAvKQxmvLERG3CTc4E-C1PQRvZ5OSio7DwQTdC5JqHzYNtYKxJqwMGrXRRNcPVQSdbkpUnRP8ULv7h1uze4HOVqo1l9omlUea5pFhKSSqHuBkkwD2obwZqk65Uft-sN3iyayPtu7vrIRI_L_2tnC4Eix1oHKjuaEAKj1-UBJcZ4h67QXpQYxqNTVdpTRFzXFvX7SKylPSMmY2vIVxILmaqm9U8eiYD6IWc%3D)**

**I’m in a tough race. My home district is currently a toss-up, and we need to ensure EVERY undecided voter sees this on TV.**

clean_body: As a working mother who pulled herself up from her bootstraps, achieved the American Dream, and is now in the final weeks of a Congressional campaign, | Peter, Unlike most of these professional politicians, I didn’t have a privileged leg up or a family member that could make some introductions for me to get to where I am today. So let me introduce myself – I started as a single mom, working as a waitress and bartender. Every penny that didn’t go towards providing a stable life for my children went towards college classes, which I took when I could. At age 39, I graduated law school. I won’t lie and paint some idealistic picture; it was a struggle to get there, but it was all so worth it. The type of experience you gain in life by pulling yourself up by your bootstraps is something that can’t be bought or taught at the country club. That’s what this campaign is about. It’s about representing the average American. It’s about the mom with three kids trying to balance a full-time job and soccer practice. It’s about the blue-collar worker saving for their child’s college fund. It’s about you – and that’s why As someone that built my American Dream from the ground up, I’m in a tough race. My home district is currently a toss-up, and we need to ensure EVERY undecided voter sees this on TV. Democratic control of DC has to end. Between sky-rocketing food costs, unstable economic futures, and families making the unfathomable decisions of heating their home or putting gas in the car – we can’t afford much more. | Resources for Hurricane Season
---
| | |
---|---
|
FROM MY SENATE DESK

Hurricane season is upon us; and despite our mountainous district being far from the ocean, we are not exempt from experiencing the effects of a hurricane.

Following are hurricane preparedness and emergency services resources to help keep you and your family safe. Please keep them available should you come to need them.

To get legislative news closer to the time it's happening, be sure to follow me on [Facebook](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0012S5RPVBryLesZ3z0Zuv1vrmzCcR-XbLqfAzQHvufUp4E9nR7pgVI-rWcD4SNPso0GS2Hn_I7LB8gA__0F7GPDpTtk08TrozTCWJbuazmIjM-3lTlfA5DoYUY4xT8mvsX5pnE8HF7rpwONf50KpTCIcyL_0ZUvMzGcnwjjmqa19Y=&c=t-_qBMniHZmWBtBj2EJU4wBrxJpSOyb-w7L3dGjz02bb3TsUJ-67RQ==&ch=WgPRZRwoHfBrd3ObW_c-QXUT60kR4bPcg8vdjLHodTWcwNk2Etjqmw==) or frequently visit my [website](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0012S5RPVBryLesZ3z0Zuv1vrmzCcR-XbLqfAzQHvufUp4E9nR7pgVI-u2U0sy3Xtd74vcSpUs9bLAL1utu0yTBPKAjvKzkNzeENoQmw252x9VDQmT2hxuKfQd8Hj5uX2JgzhezSlWW-3Q=&c=t-_qBMniHZmWBtBj2EJU4wBrxJpSOyb-w7L3dGjz02bb3TsUJ-67RQ==&ch=WgPRZRwoHfBrd3ObW_c-QXUT60kR4bPcg8vdjLHodTWcwNk2Etjqmw==).

We need to make sure we do all we can to motivate Democrats to turn out this November. We all know what’s at stake – and we can’t afford to get complacent as Democrats. We need to work like everything is on the line – _because it is._

Their national campaign arm is raking in money to boost their candidates, and the GOP’s top leaders, like Kevin McCarthy, are being deployed to districts everywhere, trying to mobilize their base to flip seats red and destroy our majority. They’re even competing in seats where President Biden won by double digits.

We don’t have to match them dollar for dollar, team, but we do have to up our ground game to make sure we can counter their efforts every step of the way.

subject: giving up ➡

body:
You can still save the day but time is of the essence.
Peter, I'm devastated.
Just a few short months ago, Republicans were up by double digits and outraising the Democrats in key battleground races across the country.
_Nancy Pelosi looked like she was on the verge of losing her gavel forever. Far-Left progressives and socialists? Bound for the history books. Then everything changed..._
**The Democrats went into full-on panic mode. **They mobilized an army of Liberal megadonors, they bullied tech companies into running their fundraising ads, they rushed field teams into swing states, they launched smear campaigns against our Pro-Trump friends, they blanketed social media with attack ads, and they rallied the Liberal Media to run cover for them.
[**NOW -- FOR THE FIRST TIME THIS YEAR -- THE DEMOCRATS HAVE TAKEN THE LEAD IN THE NATIONAL POLLS, AND THE BATTLE FOR CONGRESS IS OFFICIALLY A COIN TOSS.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61435517:JQwwLzVcN:m:1:3253819041:11E4316572FC022A3DBB54C3183A90A5:r)
We're on the verge of LOSING the House and Senate.
The number one reason the Democrats are ahead is they're crushing us in fundraising and the resources we have to fight back are severely depleted. **Frankly, we're running on fumes!**
It's officially an emergency situation, so I'll cut to the chase:
[**I'm asking you to to make a small -- but critically important -- donation to help fund our final campaign operations to win back control of Congress.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61435517:JQwwLzVcN:m:1:3253819041:11E4316572FC022A3DBB54C3183A90A5:r)
I told my team we need to raise $100,000 by tomorrow morning or it'll be too late to save us, and the Democrats will win. _We badly need your help with this. It isn't just another fundraising deadline -- IT'S FOR ALL THE MARBLES!_[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61435517:JQwwLzVcN:m:1:3253819041:11E4316572FC022A3DBB54C3183A90A5:r)
**[Pitch In Twenty-Five Bucks ->](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61435518:JQwwLzVcN:m:1:3253819041:11E4316572FC022A3DBB54C3183A90A5:r)**
**[Pitch In Thirty Bucks ->](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61435518:JQwwLzVcN:m:1:3253819041:11E4316572FC022A3DBB54C3183A90A5:r)**
**[Pitch In Fifty Bucks ->](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61435519:JQwwLzVcN:m:1:3253819041:11E4316572FC022A3DBB54C3183A90A5:r)**
Our hopes of saving this country hinge entirely on loyal grassroots supporters like you.
**The Democrats have a network of big donors, the tech companies are wrapped around their finger, and the Liberal Media does their bidding. There's no changing that. **
_But you can do something about it. You can still save the day but time is of the essence._
[**I know I'm asking a lot from you but this is too important to ignore. We have no choice: we must hit this deadline. Otherwise, we might as well just give up.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61435517:JQwwLzVcN:m:1:3253819041:11E4316572FC022A3DBB54C3183A90A5:r)
Can we count on you?
For America,
Steve Scalise
