name: Candace Owens, Co-founder of BLEXIT
subject: The most personal email I’ve ever sent you
body:
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61416937:JL5yrzVZN:m:1:3346849603:0A1A3ACDEB924F502B040DB00047CEEE:r)

Peter,

This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

**For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop.** In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

Our message to America's black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

[_**Please support the BLEXIT Foundation 's mission today by helping me reach our goal of raising $25,000 from new online donors. You can click here to donate.**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61416937:JL5yrzVZN:m:1:3346849603:0A1A3ACDEB924F502B040DB00047CEEE:r)

**_Now I 'll share my story_... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.**

Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking.

We're taught to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG.

I've dealt with racism... _**I 've even received death threats**_. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable.

But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up.

I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters.

[_**Peter, I am inviting you to support the BLEXIT Foundation and help us spread our winning message of entrepreneurship, school choice, faith, and family. My goal is to raise $25,000 from online supporters to fund our mission. Please click here to donate $25, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount. **_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61416937:JL5yrzVZN:m:1:3346849603:0A1A3ACDEB924F502B040DB00047CEEE:r)

I am breaking the rules.

It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... _I 'm not doing that_.

You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country.

So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.**Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don 't want to miss).**

When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a "think tank", but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting "DO-tank". We're doing things no other organization in the country is doing.

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for:

* **School Choice:** Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. [_**You can support BLEXIT 's efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61416937:JL5yrzVZN:m:1:3346849603:0A1A3ACDEB924F502B040DB00047CEEE:r)

* **Criminal Justice Reform:** The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by making a donation here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61416937:JL5yrzVZN:m:1:3346849603:0A1A3ACDEB924F502B040DB00047CEEE:r)

* **Entrepreneurship:** I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61416937:JL5yrzVZN:m:1:3346849603:0A1A3ACDEB924F502B040DB00047CEEE:r)

* **Teaching History: **Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation teach real American history by donating here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61416937:JL5yrzVZN:m:1:3346849603:0A1A3ACDEB924F502B040DB00047CEEE:r)

* **Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we've allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore.

The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. [_**Please support BLEXIT 's events and help us spread our message by donating here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61416937:JL5yrzVZN:m:1:3346849603:0A1A3ACDEB924F502B040DB00047CEEE:r)

What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor.

clean_body: Peter, This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation. Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation. For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop. In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities. Our message to America's black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture. Now I 'll share my story... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities. Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking. We're taught to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals. This is WRONG. I've dealt with racism... I 've even received death threats. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable. But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up. I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters. I am breaking the rules. It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... I 'm not doing that. You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country. We're doing things no other organization in the country is doing. The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. Criminal Justice Reform: The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities. Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message. Entrepreneurship: I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire. BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. Our new Events webpage is up and running! We are updating this daily. Check it out at: https://www.karinaforcongress.com/events

Friday, October 7th

Meet & Greet: Oct 7 @ 7-8:30pm. Hosted by Jack & Charmaine Yoest. Cost: Free. Location: provided upon registration. Register here: https://tinyurl.com/Oct7Meet-Greet. PLEASE SHARE THE FLYERS AND INVITE YOUR FRIENDS AND FAMILY to attend.

body:
There is nothing easy about growing up as a poor Black girl in the segregated South
| | |
---
Friend: Each and every day, it is not lost on me that I'm in what will undoubtedly be the most expensive race for the U.S. Senate in 2022 – a race that could decide the Senate majority and will be anything but easy.
But I know a thing or two about persevering, and _winning_ , even when the odds are stacked against me.
I've overcome plenty of adversity in my life, friend. **There is nothing easy about growing up as a poor Black girl in the segregated South.** But my family's faith, and faith in opportunity, taught me perseverance. It was my family, particularly my mother's words of "never tire of doing good, Val," that pushed me to where I am today.
I carry the spirit of her words with me even still – as I reflect on my career of service to Floridians and my path to being a candidate for U.S. Senate.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51517190/369558708/983517820?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk4561-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwYWI3MGJjYy00MzNmLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgzMmU0Y2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=cXT3D4gQlpfSFnqST9h3Orjo1gI9KwAwu4VNtm5_63Q=)
**There was nothing easy about being a first-generation college graduate** – nor was it easy working my way up the ranks of the Orlando Police Department. For 27 years, I served when it wasn't exactly ordinary to see a woman on the force, let alone a Black woman. But I never tired, and eventually, I became the first woman to lead my department as chief of police.
And friend, I know firsthand that there's nothing easy about winning elections in Florida. My first run for Congress was one of my toughest fights – but even in defeat I never tired, because I knew I could do good for my community. And it certainly wasn't easy to hold a lawless president – a habitual offender – to account. | | **LAW ENFORCEMENT STANDS WITH MATT JACOBS** Jacobs receives endorsements of CA-26 law enforcement organizations;Brownley fails to secure law enforcement support **Thousand Oaks, CA -** Matt Jacobs, Federal Prosecutor, and nominee for U.S. Congress in
California’s 26th District, issued the following statement regarding the overwhelming support he
has received from local law enforcement.
---
---
_“I’m deeply honored to have the endorsement and overwhelming support of law __enforcement here in our community,” _Jacobs said._ “I want to thank the brave men and __women of law enforcement for everything you do to keep us safe. And I want you to __know that I will always have your back.”_
_“My opponent – 30-year career politician Julia Brownley – can't say the __same. Instead of supporting police, she has demonized them – falsely claiming that __‘those meant to serve and protect end up doing just the opposite.’ Her legislative record __is similarly extreme: Brownley has voted to defund the police, to eliminate legal __protections for law enforcement officers, and for early release of violent felons._
_“Brownley’s anti-police, soft-on-crime policies have made the residents of Ventura __County and Los Angeles County less safe. The people of our community deserve to be __represented by someone who puts the well-being of law-abiding citizens and victims __before criminals – someone who values and understands the service and sacrifice of the __men and women who protect our community, often at great personal risk.”_ _###_ **About Matt Jacobs -** Born and raised in Ventura County, Matt Jacobs devoted his career to serving our country and keeping our community safe. As a federal prosecutor, Matt took on our country’s worst enemies – terrorists, child sex traffickers, fentanyl dealers – and won. Now Matt’s running for Congress to get our country back on track by taking on the out-of-touch career politicians, like Julia Brownley, who’ve failed us. Learn more about Matt here: [“Defending the American Dream.”](https://link.mattjacobsforcongress.com/u/click?_t=efc64eece5bd468cad54456b97abcf7f&_m=11f0d798a02649c0aa0ea072a060d5f7&_e=fME8NxQ6bBFbrieGbdS7O9AjpsIZdomf72ADecDyVV_RIWznqgl1aNwl4cWKaPsDUcdPBYymGPrGAs5xc9JXCglpY-fWqdEKsty2V_MEbvpjo2zYuBrz2WhLXErJqxtyP_aCxyMRrDoLAzgbvWSa0o_93RqbGYX7XHSGnzXlFHKG0SXFbNXYMGkvWcH-7_KSG22VU6Ir7bts0oWeQzEZ6khXOHaIGIjXaMtSkBe7iw0%3D)

| | Dear Friend, There's this notion nowadays that just because an idea is popular, it must be true.

It's a narrative that you'll often see pushed by a dysfunctional media or toxic culture. And as long as the idea is considered "correct" by the "right" people like TV talking heads, celebrities, or the masses on social media, the general public believes it.

That's why the Libertas Institute published this eBook in our Tuttle Twins series: **[_The Tuttle Rebuttals: 40 Responses to Popular Political and Economic Myths._](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zfimn1fesoc0cqd5k9pr6948j2q1c0vmhd87skl8_rp22sh2s8i66or1cpieaoj2c5h2bs)**
---
| [](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2z8umret3j7tpjv3ef8r5fhf0rbglgvpio937vgq8_rp22sh2s8i66or1cpieaoj2c5h2bs)
---
| | And today, we want to send a copy to your inbox for FREE.

Inside this important eBook, you'll get a clear analysis of some of the biggest political and economic myths infecting our world today like:
* Overpopulation is destroying the world
* Global climate change can be reversed by law
* Capitalism creates winners and losers
* Socialism helps the poor

You can get your free copy using this secure link:

**[https://act.libertasutah.org/tt-the-tuttle-rebuttals](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2z36k9fhu5kfeema53c717j8ijtsq5bf3bsqke3q0_rp22sh2s8i66or1cpieaoj2c5h2bs)**

I'd also love for you to share this book with at least 5 people you know--especially any children in your family. My hope is that they will enjoy the same benefits you do when you read this book. And then, we can crush these myths once and for all.

Please use this link to get instant access to your free copy of _**[The Tuttle Rebuttals: 40 Responses to Popular Political and Economic Myths](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2z714lbm7n4am1c7ttbnsoot1u922onqnrn3l5qn0_rp22sh2s8i66or1cpieaoj2c5h2bs)**_ today!
Thank you,

Connor Boyack
Author, Tuttle Twins
Founder, Libertas Institute

Peter,

Unlike most of these professional politicians, I didn’t have a privileged leg up or a family member that could make some introductions for me to get to where I am today.

So let me introduce myself – **[my name is April Becker and I’m running for Congress.](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=80f4393b2ff64e1fbdeb8e88dc1a508b&_e=QKk6bKyWrTqtab-IbHDzW38lwyjlPGCqX5afbAHcM3u-0DU8at6_xY8buvqxfpOTMfykBeU77rdom91f_9cD5bf8ommyU4x7ONFteY-VTYDfElVHb28aoX1WHvLyl6l9yJUpoomlD3RgSw7xmBxf91IWlL52Mx8h1Loft-YvfNKzKK2nnrSQDhEHC2Meof-DSuHNM_H1QQkbibDFA_ebd09cbrXgVDGscYXczzsre_2eBRPhDfok_niacPTTdAn7S2RMcWbyDpgwiLowmyB9eudLjb5KIxi_M9xQg0yhtSAHmyUKb5HBnQykVnTSVSF3Y7BBJrMbM4Ur3ylQXzXdQGs2qoD51_hKIeiaQNJR3Fb1zyA97mIytJIfUpC22F6wkmt98Ibnt-S0r5ekfDbvI8mfLxvvFsPGcBckZQh7yU2JxJ0XYNpnqxoS-ASUeAQw)**

**I started as a single mom, working as a waitress and bartender. Every penny that didn’t go towards providing a stable life for my children went towards college classes, which I took when I could.**

At age 39, I graduated law school. I won’t lie and paint some idealistic picture; **it was a struggle to get there, but it was all so worth it.** The type of experience you gain in life by pulling yourself up by your bootstraps is something that can’t be bought or taught at the country club.

That’s what this campaign is about. It’s about representing the average American. It’s about the mom with three kids trying to balance a full-time job and soccer practice. It’s about the blue-collar worker saving for their child’s college fund.

So let me introduce myself – I started as a single mom, working as a waitress and bartender. Every penny that didn’t go towards providing a stable life for my children went towards college classes, which I took when I could. At age 39, I graduated law school. I won’t lie and paint some idealistic picture; it was a struggle to get there, but it was all so worth it. The type of experience you gain in life by pulling yourself up by your bootstraps is something that can’t be bought or taught at the country club. That’s what this campaign is about. It’s about representing the average American. It’s about the mom with three kids trying to balance a full-time job and soccer practice. Canvassing neighborhoods, talking with voters and getting the word out about Erik Aadland was the order of the week.

Fremont County Area Coordinator Cindy hosted tables at the Valley Strong Community Dinner. Erik's supporters and volunteers joined Westcliffe residents for great food and conversation.
| |
---|---
|
Next up, Cindy and friends met with Erik in Florence to join floats, bands, animals, Shriners and all the great things we have come to expect at the Florence Pioneer Days Parade. The event included celebration of Florence's 150th Anniversary (AKA their Sesquicentennial for the epeolatrists in the audience).
| |
---|---
|
Broomfield Area Coordinator Thea organized volunteers to talk with King Sooper shoppers near Legacy High School in Broomfield. It was great talking to folks and hearing about their concerns.

Thea also headed up Erik's contingent at the Broomfield's favorite event; Broomfield Days festival and parade. The gang joined Grand Marshall Jay Willey for the celebration's main event.
| |
---|---
|
In Teller county on Saturday, Erik joined volunteers to talk with our neighbors in Woodland Park. Teller County Coordinator Tim, rallied his volunteers who, along with Erik, visited over 200 homes and talked with voters around town.

Park County Area Coordinator David and his volunteers gathered at the Burland Ranchettes Baseball Field yesterday to visit our neighbors in Bailey and talk about the issues.
| |
---|---
|
Lively discussions ensued and Bailey folks were pleased to hear about Erik's plan to represent us in the US House.

Arvada Area Coordinator Marlene brought her volunteer force to the Leyden Rock community of Arvada this morning. A respectable size group walked through the neighborhood and shared Erik's word.

Other volunteers are making phone calls each day on behalf of Erik's campaign to become our Representative for the U.S. House in Washington DC.
You could be a part of this fun too! We are always happy to welcome new folks to the crusade. Lots of nice weather now and several more weekends to join us! Click the button below to find out about it.

## About Aadland For Congress
---
| |
---
| Erik's effort to represent Colorado District 7 (CD7) is a true grass-roots campaign. There is no family fortune behind this drive; no generations of beer barons, or Fat-Cat donors from California and New York backing our organization. Volunteers and professionals began joining the cause to help send Erik to Washington in March of 2021. Staff personnel now cross the spectrum of political pundits, professionals, friends and neighbors.
You can stand with Erik by contributing to our cause. We can't do it alone, but together we can do anything.

## About Erik
---
| |
---
| Jefferson County resident Erik Aadland is a West Point graduate and a twice-decorated Bronze Star veteran--one for valor--from his time in Iraq and Afghanistan. Concluding his army career in 2011 as a Captain, he pursued a career in the oil and natural gas industry with his work culminating as a project manager directing the onshore construction of the Leviathan Project in Dor, Israel. This project resulted in Israel being a net exporter of natural gas and becoming energy independent. Erik holds a master's degree in the field of psychology. He is a devoted husband and proud father of three children.

Hey Peter,
Greetings from the open road! Barbara and I loaded up our two golden retrievers, Allie and BooBoo, and we’re more than a week into our cross-country tour supporting gun violence prevention candidates. We wanted to give you a quick update to see what we’ve been up to!
Last week we made it to Colorado, a state very similar to Virginia: a purple state that has been touched too often by heinous gun violence. Tom Sullivan is a friend we met after Alison was killed. He lost his son, Alex, in the terrible shooting at an Aurora, Colorado movie theater. We joined Moms Demand Action volunteers for canvassing with Tom for his election this November.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/95557/images/IMG_1071%20Large.jpeg][https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/95557/images/IMG_1056%20Large.jpeg]
Just like us, Tom took it upon himself to honor his child with action. He won a seat to the Colorado state House in 2018 and is now running for state senate. Colorado has enacted some wonderful gun safety laws in recent memory and Tom has been a leader in the effort, including sponsoring the bill that created Extreme Risk Protection Orders there. The QAnon army is after him for it and the head of the GOP in Colorado even tried to recall Tom [http://www.cpr.org/2019/05/13/colorado-gop-vice-chair-initiates-recall-against-rep-tom-sullivan-who-sponsored-red-flag-gun-law/] in a stunt to silence him. Check out more about Tom here [http://sullivanforcolorado.com/] and donate to his campaign [secure.actblue.com/donate/sullivanwebsite] if you can!
After canvassing with Tom, we stopped by RAWTools [http://springs.rawtools.org] in Aurora. They are an organization that takes assault weapons and turns them into literal plowshares like spades and garden tools. For anyone who hates the violence and destruction guns cause, it's a real treat to help destroy them, which is exactly what Barbara got to do!
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/95557/images/IMG_1094%20Large.jpeg]
And then last night, we were honored to be hosted by our friend Pat Maisch and other survivors of the shooting in Tuscon, Arizona that killed six and wounded many more, including Gabby Giffords. More than ten years after that day, their work to change laws and save lives continues.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/95557/images/FdwbM8yVUAYWb9p.jpeg]
Look out for more updates soon as we stay in touch from the road!
As always, donate on ActBlue [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/andy-s-fight-1] to support my effort and thank you to those who have already contributed!
Until next time,
Andy

PO Box 1207
Collinsville, VA 24078

name: Conservative Liberty Wire
subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. This sponsored message from Conservative Liberty Wire is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=ef3d600316f1498f82c6af54a662cf5c&_e=8LxFqqrMsL5NbiIATu1TlN3Uru8E5jJEOjjjaQmrptdE_wbal5vo2zeWykl3uzS_X3894yxCUzVqmxRrp_gvyk0ayn0ihz_Zr7Q6VRo-7H17pv79-RirwPZtDxLif0ukZxAX8yP-aCR4tDrmpdSAS_E3hB0IIXsU92W7huRao2h26cED9n1iHRQS40kc3IgP0s4ZYwvexGeSyctadtVSOcvL-XlTp1tf0a6VtPqs5-mHQsnUDfIJYYwlgEIZ1ekjQWp25dUfB25zOhD9SaVfpq39kjjzk2wWNTsE2OhfGyl5m0RfIR_wJDu0IGwk9LEsrXr_mbeFivbX3Bjmbt83bZfu9rrfcL-FK9V72t5CpPIpU5qurCjWYtZ2eHyNXoIdQRe3WzBgzpI3RWGmDdc-6Q%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American,
I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.
It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future.
A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.
That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.**
By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders.
You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below:
**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=ef3d600316f1498f82c6af54a662cf5c&_e=8LxFqqrMsL5NbiIATu1TlN3Uru8E5jJEOjjjaQmrptdE_wbal5vo2zeWykl3uzS_X3894yxCUzVqmxRrp_gvyk0ayn0ihz_Zr7Q6VRo-7H17pv79-RirwPZtDxLif0ukZxAX8yP-aCR4tDrmpdSAS_E3hB0IIXsU92W7huRao2h26cED9n1iHRQS40kc3IgP0s4ZYwvexGeSyctadtVSOcvL-XlTp1tf0a6VtPqs5-ngoDrKggSuFv-YkRDY4c-lfzbD9WxAuW-w0MA_EiLgO_74HrRdQXNTb75jCebLnevibaU9SMK5Uapm4_iobJKoWmKqV9FHfQ0LT3omU7fki5lVSHF9oZ_CG9uDqG8rp72Vi8gO2uPi4jVsw2oPZXeYgoD84GNSr_GgCOEdHEwzuw%3D%3D)**
For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government.
**But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.**
This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.
Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states.
These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale's Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College.
**And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future.**
So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.
**You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:**
**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=ef3d600316f1498f82c6af54a662cf5c&_e=8LxFqqrMsL5NbiIATu1TlN3Uru8E5jJEOjjjaQmrptdE_wbal5vo2zeWykl3uzS_X3894yxCUzVqmxRrp_gvyk0ayn0ihz_Zr7Q6VRo-7H17pv79-RirwPZtDxLif0ukZxAX8yP-aCR4tDrmpdSAS_E3hB0IIXsU92W7huRao2h26cED9n1iHRQS40kc3IgP0s4ZYwvexGeSyctadtVSOcvL-XlTp1tf0a6VtPqs5-kTNIahoTopSIWikyYwVwpkYPGWCrH3hXluOt-fwRBDK54dQMMzR3jmq225KtpKrD5qWhWCs-GBjiT_Bw_G9Bl29TOUupEFvf3yUwUQjfFyrrv23YW8CKwLmDRtSUK7u-o_2BhiOSgiIqtPVCPZwS7lNT1dwdcQZhKL4CY14sKJaQ%3D%3D)**
And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.
Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.
The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work.
Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

You can complete the National Survey on Presidential Selection by using the link below: For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty. This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include: Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;" Reaching over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with Imprimis , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty; Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people; Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and Restoring excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale's Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide. Your answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future. So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below: And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Being raised by two working parents who sometimes struggled to make ends meet wasn’t always easy.
Flying combat missions in Desert Storm wasn’t easy.
Watching Gabby fight so hard in the early days, weeks, and months of her recovery wasn’t easy.
Running for the U.S. Senate and having Donald Trump and National Republicans relentlessly attack me personally — that hasn’t been easy either.
But as a kid, I had my brother Scott.
In combat, I had my wingmen.
With Gabby, we had our whole community offering support.

The children of Tennessee are our priority, and we will continue to fight to ensure a bright future for every single one of them.

Onward,

_“The most liberal nominee in Iowa Senate history”
“Radical”
“Socialist”_
Gotta love it!

Calling me “radical” is laughable when Chuck Grassley supports a complete ban on abortion and letting literally anyone buy an AR-15 without even a background check. **But there’s one attack that I absolutely won’t take lying down, and that’s Chuck Grassley’s attacking me for serving our country for 36 years in the U.S. Navy.**
Grassley is now trying to say that because I enlisted in the military at age 19, because my deployments meant that my family had to move from state-to-state and country-to-country... that I’m not an Iowan anymore.
Chuck Grassley wants to pretend that I wasn’t raised in rural, northwest Iowa. He ignores the enormous sacrifices that my family – my wife and my kids – made to allow me to serve in the Navy.

subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vWQRb8fhNc

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only
take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our
nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives-but
supported by many well-meaning Americans-to change the way we
elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the
Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWQRb8fhNc

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear Fellow American,

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent
matter.

It will only take a moment of your time, but
the topic is vital to our nation's future.

A movement is growing, led by
progressives-but supported by many well-meaning Americans-to
change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do
away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our
Constitution.

That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a
National Survey on Presidential Selection.

By completing this survey and returning it to
me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more
clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning
this issue-views we will make available to policymakers and
opinion leaders.

You can complete the National Survey on
Presidential Selection by using the link below:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60842897:WQRb8fhNc:m:3:2532013465:B2140312E171C4691AACADF7031735C6:r

For most of our nation's history, the
Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution,
was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to
preserving free and representative government.

But today, more than a dozen states have
joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional
bulwark of liberty.

This movement to undermine the Constitution
has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to
provide young people with a proper grounding in American
civics-too many Americans simply don't understand the importance
of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because of this, Hillsdale College has
expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide,
directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states.

These efforts, which aim to counter the
Left's domination over most of our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide
through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The
Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over 5.6 million households and
businesses nationwide with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of
liberty;

Promoting constitutional education
through social media outlets popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of
America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across
America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education
through Hillsdale's Barney Charter School Initiative, which
launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools
nationwide.

Your answers to the National Survey on
Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most
effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the
importance of the Constitution to liberty-including the
importance of the Electoral College.

And this is especially important in this
critical time for America's future.

So please share your views on this urgent
topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection
and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a
few minutes of your time.

You can take the survey using this secure
link I've provided below:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60842897:WQRb8fhNc:m:3:2532013465:B2140312E171C4691AACADF7031735C6:r

And after you take your survey, I hope you
will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a
tax-deductible gift.

Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing
truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its
extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept
ONE PENNY of government funding-not even indirectly in the form
of federal or state student grants or loans.

The support of private citizens like you is
essential to our work.

Please represent your state and take the
National Survey on Presidential Selection today. Thank you for
your time and attention-and for your friendship and support of
liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since
1844

subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zt3f7c6d53aff0h561t6p6s8bvr8u4hphd7e6bng_rp22sh2s8i66or1cpieapj5c5h238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq8ddl69qbcd1jm8p79d9j6iprect66uqrf91ieoob9crl6uie5sj2ucqr7d34esr3dcdjmuqraodjchh6ac5impi69otl6dr36tr261qb0o9mcthbbdtnq9o74p1m62p6csjk65r61o5kckoe1d9hcjj6cphh6sqrcc3nclj30t5lm9jr1db5e8iv0)
This sponsored message from American Briefing is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zh5u69qarvtsb30v9q94m9vkj80un91rpg5ddbog_rp22sh2s8i66or1cpieapj5c5h2bs) Dear Fellow American, Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important. To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled “The Second World Wars.” Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. clean_body: We need to elect more candidates who will take on corporate greed, authoritarianism, and bigotry and who are prepared to fight for justice. | | Derek -- I am writing to ask you to split a $10 contribution to the Democratic National Committee and Mandela Barnes's campaign for U.S. Senate in Wisconsin. I hope you will give me a moment to explain why your contribution is so important to his campaign. Mandela is running to defeat Republican incumbent Ron Johnson, one of the most reactionary and self-serving members of the U.S. Senate. A recent Marquette poll shows Mandela down by one point, and he is up against some very powerful special interests who are spending obscene amounts of money to try to defeat him. So Mandela needs your help, especially before his FEC fundraising deadline at the end of this month. He’s funding his campaign the right way -- from lots of people making small donations. That is the only way he is going to have the resources to win this race, and that is why I need to ask: At this moment in American history -- in the midst of massive income and wealth inequality, and the existential threat of climate change -- it has never been more important to elect candidates like Mandela who will fight for the working class of this country. We need to elect more candidates who will take on corporate greed, authoritarianism, and bigotry and who are prepared to fight for justice. In order to do that, we must bring our people together in a multi-generational, multi-racial movement to take on the big-money interests that have so much political and economic power in our country. Mandela Barnes is building that kind of movement through his campaign in Wisconsin. And if he wins in November, he will continue our struggle for justice in the U.S. Senate. First, we need to come together to defeat a Republican extremist who denies the reality of climate change, participated in a scheme to overturn the 2020 election results, and has repeatedly sided with corporate interests at the expense of working people. But this Wisconsin Senate race isn't just about replacing Ron Johnson. It's also about expanding the Senate majority so we can have the votes to continue passing meaningful legislation to address the many crises we face. Mandela Barnes is in a very close race right now, and he is relying on grassroots support in order to fund his campaign between now and Election Day. So I am asking you one more time: We are engaged in many struggles right now. We are trying to save the planet from the ravages of climate change. We're trying to create an economy that works for all and not just the billionaire class. We're trying to defend our democracy against those who are moving us toward authoritarianism. And that's just to name a few. But, in the midst of all these struggles, we cannot simply remain on the defensive. We need to continue building our movement to transform this country. That means standing with candidates like Mandela Barnes who will take on powerful special interests. Thank you for adding a contribution to his campaign today. In solidarity, Bernie Bernie Sanders U.S. Senator, Vermont The DNC's 2022 Congressional Split Series helps fundraise for and raise awareness around down-ballot Democrats in some of the most important races across the country. | | | Hey there,

The importance of this race has become even more clear. I am running for Congress to advocate for the best interests of this district, the country, and the people & families who live here. My opponent has chosen to continue to abuse his power and disrespect taxpayers.
---
| [ ](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=5cf53459c9&e=356c0699dd)
---
| _Read more[here](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=a818ed67fc&e=356c0699dd)._

I have been talking with voters across the district about our vision for Wisconsin that gives everyday working families a shot at the American Dream, while Fitgerald’s vision is one that includes him hiding in Washington and making taxpayers pay the entire bill for his campaign flyers.

**No other Wisconsin U.S. House members have sent out more taxpayer funded messages than Fitzgerald. **

Scott Fitzgerald hasn’t bothered to engage with the regular folks of the 5th Congressional District, and **why would he when he can just force us to fund his campaign?** My goal as your next Congressman is to be transparent, open. and honest. * We’re down 2 points in the polls.

* We’re $27,877 SHORT of our $100k Quarterly Fundraising Goal.

* We have just 2 days to make up the difference.

This campaign has captured the hearts of the people of Pennsylvania. Our rallies are bigger. Our momentum is bigger. Our passion is bigger.
Fact is, _no one_ wants Josh Shapiro to be Governor of Pennsylvania. His entire campaign is based _solely_ on lies, smears, and fearmongering about me.

body:

Derek was honored to meet with educators this past weekend
Peter,

Derek was honored to meet with educators this past weekend to hear their concerns, and how he can continue fighting for them -- and students -- in Congress.

[](https://act.myngp.com/el/2s58IklXjIa_3pO_l-qITqBlz7cdYYX_vDjBRv2Vakk=/WEo71d4b79yX1xvacL4pHV93Al8pNiztZRttEbBTPcg=?ms=em22_220928_tchpet_adv_gq_act___TK_ettx&refcode=em22_220928_tchpet_adv_gq_act___TK_ettx&source=em22_220928_tchpet_adv_gq_act___TK_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_220928_tchpet_adv_gq_act___TK_ettx&utm_medium=email&em={{EmailAddress%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&fn={{FirstName%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&ln={{LastName%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&pc={{ZipCode%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&contactdata={{ContactData}})

As the son of two public school teachers, Derek learned to appreciate the value of education from a young age. He knows that educators all across the country - especially during the height of the pandemic - have gone the extra mile. These past few years have been tough for kids (and parents) and educators have consistently cared for the well-being of students and worked to help them develop the tools they need to become tomorrow's leaders.

Peter - many educators have rallied together in the wake of the pandemic to fight to support students in getting access to important resources. And they continue to find creative and engaging ways to serve their students.

_Gabby and me during her recovery_

Peter —

When I think about the toughest times in my life, I’m thankful I’ve always had a support system to help me through.

Being raised by two working parents who sometimes struggled to make ends meet wasn’t always easy.

Flying combat missions in Desert Storm wasn’t easy.

Watching Gabby fight so hard in the early days, weeks, and months of her recovery wasn’t easy.

Running for the U.S. Senate and having Donald Trump and National Republicans relentlessly attack me personally — that hasn’t been easy either.

But as a kid, I had my brother Scott.

In combat, I had my wingmen.

With Gabby, we had our whole community offering support.

And in these campaigns, I have you.

subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. This sponsored message from Conservatives Give is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=66c60419db074742b9eb05a56fdedf03&_e=sBoKnj2Vl4bmQq0-V06Fr1-ROJaV4CYkf66-TXL1X9fOjASQl-95YpZaWGaylVxcmFrIU1I1IUfqz2fYUc7CqccBEU-8CgB_LAj--k2w7I4x6Gb5WIsZH2C8fgdcE4l2WRLUZ1x_HZMH39fqiAYiTMojz5SiAy7LpPbeEnRzr9UbluU3vBPozHKUVPl-6ZyrLvXxeg9Eb4liIy46yBOexXvZNEC2VnxaWEWbhW6YUkxLKkHTORrdUIeF5XjAtZQfMNRoUtdvVjjDyYSN3uZCO3nx4y_fWc4XkaLvihYqBpCBKJj8E9EqRcfdyyfyMDSal6RHEu7--sAynpCOkPrhF6IoNL6w6srirTMqGp6tg5z-av9rpeWbBltOJCxzUQAkyrf-KpCByqY2DDVuI7GSCA%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=66c60419db074742b9eb05a56fdedf03&_e=sBoKnj2Vl4bmQq0-V06Fr1-ROJaV4CYkf66-TXL1X9fOjASQl-95YpZaWGaylVxcmFrIU1I1IUfqz2fYUc7CqccBEU-8CgB_LAj--k2w7I4x6Gb5WIsZH2C8fgdcE4l2WRLUZ1x_HZMH39fqiAYiTMojz5SiAy7LpPbeEnRzr9UbluU3vBPozHKUVPl-6ZyrLvXxeg9Eb4liIy46yBOexXvZNEC2VnxaWEWbhW6YUkyi0yqD6Bg2WoVv2CBhmVMGo6F5UdX0tFHJz4XO6SiOaXl09uRZ2vGMuyECrg3SsFlkBrhmK7HdMfKvQhvGTo_pwGAeglsbCOOEzkmRPiqHmtMBS9Lefg-I10n2MxQdRYCIy8Zx22aTXEPDuBAEATDFvzsBpZ-acZpUWZr3rzKCPg%3D%3D)** For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale's Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=66c60419db074742b9eb05a56fdedf03&_e=sBoKnj2Vl4bmQq0-V06Fr1-ROJaV4CYkf66-TXL1X9fOjASQl-95YpZaWGaylVxcmFrIU1I1IUfqz2fYUc7CqccBEU-8CgB_LAj--k2w7I4x6Gb5WIsZH2C8fgdcE4l2WRLUZ1x_HZMH39fqiAYiTMojz5SiAy7LpPbeEnRzr9UbluU3vBPozHKUVPl-6ZyrLvXxeg9Eb4liIy46yBOexXvZNEC2VnxaWEWbhW6YUkxt2ct0-AGpWoxwgLXc7mog8tRBugHRPh2d6x7ToGAqCdF1g-niE6DJ-2fXl4ftMXBjZ75Yuhil-UvK_QZIOfwz3ltfhzIlYukK3FO-Vq9Orfr_wMKZuRXZ8awM7pRX-ojCe3dl8epCjJctlY37Pt7EBgh6Z3noYmPLKFV44uCLHQ%3D%3D)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

[1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

Derek,

I want to tell you a story about the first time I visited the Governor’s
Mansion.

But first, this Friday marks the last day of the quarter, when our
fundraising numbers will be locked in for the last time before Election
Day. That’s why my team made a goal to raise $150,000 per day from now
through September 30.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4148?refcode=sa_em_220928_B2_SYAValedictorian_S1_T1_SYA_SL&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1002&akid=9707%2E1862389%2EZSpXe1 ]Will you invest $5 in my campaign right now to build One
Georgia, where we all thrive — and where our children are safe and
surrounded by opportunity and possibility? Your $5 donation
could help take us right over the finish line today and help us begin
opening gates of opportunity across Georgia.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4148?refcode=sa_em_220928_B2_SYAValedictorian_S1_T1_SYA_SL&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1003&akid=9707%2E1862389%2EZSpXe1 ]DONATE

In 1991, I graduated as the valedictorian of Avondale High School. Like
most Georgia valedictorians, I was invited to meet the Governor of Georgia
at the Governor’s Mansion.

It was a big deal for my family. That morning, I got up and put on my
Sunday best. My parents and I boarded the MARTA bus with the domestic
workers and mechanics who, like us, could not afford a car.

We took MARTA all the way from DeKalb County to Buckhead, got off at West
Paces Ferry Road, and walked up the long driveway to the big black gates
around the property. When we got to the guard station, the guard looked at
my parents, then he looked at me and said, “This is a private event, you
don’t belong here.”

He looked over our shoulder at the MARTA bus driving away and he told
himself a story about who would be on that bus — and in his story, they
did not belong in the Governor’s Mansion.

My parents pushed back and I got in. But looking back on that day, I don’t
remember meeting the Governor of Georgia. I don’t even remember
celebrating my accomplishments with valedictorians from 159 counties and
180 school districts. The only thing I remember is a man blocking the
gates of the most powerful place in Georgia, telling me that I did not
belong.

I have spent my life in public service opening the gates of opportunity
for those often left behind. But now, I need your help to change the face
of leadership in Georgia and win this election on November 8.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4148?refcode=sa_em_220928_B2_SYAValedictorian_S1_T1_SYA_SL&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1004&akid=9707%2E1862389%2EZSpXe1 ]So, I’m humbly asking, Derek: with
just over 48 hours left until our End
of Quarter reporting deadline, will you help show the world that Georgia
can be a state that works for all? Let’s show everyone — Brian Kemp, the
media and everyone else who counted us out — that we have a mandate to
open those gates and keep them open.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4148?refcode=sa_em_220928_B2_SYAValedictorian_S1_T1_SYA_SL&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1005&akid=9707%2E1862389%2EZSpXe1 ]DONATE

name: Bernie Sanders
subject: I am writing to ask you, friend
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Rosen for Nevada
body:
We need to elect more candidates who will take on corporate greed, authoritarianism, and bigotry and who are prepared to fight for justice.
| | |
---
Friend –
I am writing to ask you to make a $5 contribution to Mandela Barnes' campaign for U.S. Senate in Wisconsin. I hope you will give me a moment to explain why your contribution is so important to his campaign.
Mandela is running to defeat Republican incumbent Ron Johnson, one of the most reactionary and self-serving members of the U.S. Senate. A recent Marquette poll shows Mandela **down by one point** , and he is up against some very powerful special interests who are spending obscene amounts of money to try to defeat him.
**So Mandela needs your help, especially before his FEC fundraising deadline at the end of this month.**
Ron Johnson is someone who relies on corporate interests to fund his campaign. But Mandela is funding his campaign the right way – from lots of people making small donations.
**That is the only way he is going to have the resources to win this race, and that is why I need to ask:**
**[Can you please make a $5 contribution – split between Mandela Barnes' campaign and Jacky Rosen's? As long as we are in this together, we are going to send Mandela to the Senate and expand the majority.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51544595/369658041/2092305521?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5&refcode=jtk2012-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MTg4YTVhYi04MjNmLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgzMmU0Y2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=GuXacE-FN13vJK-8-5UnxZUpihV9M8G4f7VtomPsBwk=)**

At this moment in American history – in the midst of massive income and wealth inequality, a global pandemic, and the existential threat of climate change – it has never been more important to elect candidates like Mandela who will fight for the working class of this country.
We need to elect more candidates who will take on corporate greed, authoritarianism, and bigotry and who are prepared to fight for justice. In order to do that, we must bring our people together in a multi-generational, multi-racial movement to take on the big-money interests that have so much political and economic power in our country.
**Mandela Barnes is building that kind of movement through his campaign in Wisconsin. And if he wins in November, he will continue our struggle for justice in the U.S. Senate.**
First, we need to come together to defeat a Republican extremist who denies the reality of climate change, participated in a scheme to overturn the 2020 election results, and has repeatedly sided with corporate interests at the expense of working people.
But this Wisconsin Senate race isn't just about replacing Ron Johnson. It's also about expanding the Senate majority so we can finally have the votes to pass meaningful legislation to address the many crises we face.
**Mandela Barnes is in a very close race right now, and he is relying on grassroots support in order to fund his campaign between now and Election Day. So I am asking you one more time:**
**[Please make a $5 contribution, split between Mandela Barnes' campaign for U.S. Senate in Wisconsin and Jacky Rosen's in Nevada. Your contribution today will ensure Mandela has the financial resources to flip this seat.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51544600/369658046/2092305521?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5&refcode=jtk2012-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MTg4YTVhYi04MjNmLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgzMmU0Y2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=GuXacE-FN13vJK-8-5UnxZUpihV9M8G4f7VtomPsBwk=)**
We are engaged in many struggles right now. We are trying to save the planet from the ravages of climate change. We're trying to create an economy that works for all and not just the billionaire class. We're trying to defend our democracy against those who are moving us toward authoritarianism. And that's just to name a few.
But, in the midst of all these struggles, we cannot simply remain on the defensive. We need to continue building our movement to transform this country.
That means standing with candidates like Mandela Barnes who will take on powerful special interests. Thank you for adding a contribution to his campaign today.
In solidarity,

Bernie Sanders

clean_body: | | | Friend, With 6 weeks to go, I’m campaigning in Nevada alongside some incredible conservatives. Today, I’m with April Becker, who is a staunch conservative in a tough, battleground race. When I emailed you earlier this year, I explained to you just how competitive her race is. Nevada’s 3rd Congressional District is currently rated as a TOSS UP. Republican April Becker is running against liberal incumbent Susie Lee — and being outraised and outspent by her opponent. She’s running against liberal Democrat Susie Lee in one of the most competitive House races in the country. The final outcome will come down to what we can do to help April Becker in these final weeks. Every dollar that we can pour into her campaign will be an extra critical resource to fund last-minute ad buys, get-out-the-vote efforts, and more. This race will come down to the wire. Time is ticking and the more we wait to give, the harder it will be to flip this seat and flip the House. Your support will make an important difference. You know how important it is for Republicans to win Nevada up and down the ticket. Nevada is looking for leadership from people who will lower the burden of rising costs, slash the federal deficit, and stop out-of-control socialist spending sprees. If you have anything to spare please join me in helping April Becker today. My very best, Nikki Haley | | | A Note From Nikki: Growing up, smart, strong, and unconventional women were discouraged. When I ran for office, the South Carolina legislature was dominated by a Good Old Boys' Club and my opponent thought women shouldn’t be in politics. People thought I was too brown, too female, too young, too conservative, too principled. I said: Too bad. I was inspired by great women who broke barriers and defied expectations, women like Margaret Thatcher and Jeane Kirkpatrick. That’s why I wrote this book. Team, right now, this race leans in favor of Nikki, _but_ our momentum is slowing down, and we’re two days away from our CRITICAL end-of-quarter deadline.

**We reached out this morning, and we’re asking again:[Is there anything we can say to convince you to pitch in $10 right now to our end-of-quarter goal?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51546442/369662493/2010590291?refcode=em_fr_2022.09.28_b2_tn_all-nd&refcode2=6072123f-883f-ed11-b495-00224832e4ca&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjQwNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MDcyMTIzZi04ODNmLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgzMmU0Y2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=LjovXb5HlPdyFmL22KfDouBqhdjUPdm9W7d0MXY-sfQ=)**
* What if we told you that _POLITICO_ named this district “Democrats’ single best target” to flip a previously Republican-held seat?

* What if we told you that Nikki is a longtime advocate for working families who will fight to lower costs for the people of Illinois?

Supporters, These eight teachers, professors, and school counselors are running in some of the most important and competitive elections in the country. Their races may not only determine control of the United States House of Representatives, but also the future of public education in this country. [With that much at stake, we are asking everyone who cares about kids, schools, and the future of public education to give $1 directly to each of their campaigns.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/51547202/369665980/-1583390051?refcode=20220928housedirect_l1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNi8xLzg1NzI0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImJhZGExNDA1LThhM2YtZWQxMS1iNDk1LTAwMjI0ODMyZTRjYSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=_9NSn7xolBq-D-6-ZVsXCe_6gl3Gb2DhCHW-4D7XHL4=) [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/51547203/369665981/-1583390051?refcode=20220928housedirect_img&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNi8xLzg1NzI0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImJhZGExNDA1LThhM2YtZWQxMS1iNDk1LTAwMjI0ODMyZTRjYSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=_9NSn7xolBq-D-6-ZVsXCe_6gl3Gb2DhCHW-4D7XHL4=) **1) Congresswoman Katie Porter** is an icon, a professor who shows up to every committee hearing as prepared and knowledgeable as you'd expect from an accomplished educator. She's running for re-election in Orange County, where the pricey Los Angeles TV market makes it uber expensive to reach voters and share her story. **2) Greg Landsman is a former High School Spanish Teacher **running one of the most Democratic districts still held by a Republican. His opponent is obsessed with criminalizing abortion and banning birth control, but Greg can bring a teacher's common sense and focus on students back to a district that voted for Joe Biden by over 8%. **3) Congresswoman Jahana Hayes was the 2016 National Teacher of the Year. **She's one of the few classroom teachers on the House Education Committee, and dark-money, right-wing groups are targeting her with nearly $1 million in attack ads in an attempt to silence her voice. 4) **Educator Tony Vargas was a Middle School Science Teacher. **Now a State Senator, he's running in a swing district around Omaha that has been decided by less than 2% in three of the last five elections. A victory for Tony this year would go a long, long way to holding the House. **5) Christina Bohannan **grew up in a trailer with parents who never finished high school. Now, she's a **professor at the University of Iowa College of Law**. She's running the same district that was decided by just 6 votes in the last election (that 6 votes, not 6%!). **6) Kirsten Engel has 26 years of experience as an educator.** She has won election to the State Senate and won a competitive Democratic primary earlier this year. She's running in an open, Democratic-held seat and fighting against a well-connected GOP opponent who's benefitted from $1.5 million in outside support from Kevin McCarthy's allies. **7) Jackie Gordon is a long-time teacher and guidance counselor, with 30 years of professional experience as an educator. **She is also a veteran, having retired from the Army Reserve with the rank of Lieutenant Colonel. Today, Jackie is running in a Long Island district that's nearly evenly divided between Democrats and Republicans. **8) Chrissy Houlahan is a former High School Chemistry Teacher** who was inspired to run for office after attending the Women's March in 2017. She won a Republican-held seat in 2018 and was re-elected in 2020. She's running in a competitive district in Chester County, one of the most important regions in Pennsylvania. | **[DONATE DIRECTLY](https://click.everyaction.com/k/51547204/369665982/447211804?refcode=20220928housedirect_btn&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNi8xLzg1NzI0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImJhZGExNDA1LThhM2YtZWQxMS1iNDk1LTAwMjI0ODMyZTRjYSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=_9NSn7xolBq-D-6-ZVsXCe_6gl3Gb2DhCHW-4D7XHL4=)**

| | Mining Journal, Letter to the Editor Sept. 22, 2022 by Scott Emerson I am voting for Dr. Bob Lorinser for Congress because knowing him for a very long time has revealed his true character. I know he actually lives here. I know about his high ethical standards. I know how he has always been a man dedicated to service for others and to something greater than himself. I know of his intelligence, compassion, balanced wisdom and fearless independence in critical decision making. I know how he speaks truth to power, to oppose bureaucratic bungling. I know how he is always armed with facts, science and compelling logic. I know we now have a good shot at firing the MAGA robot currently holding our congressional seat, and replacing that with an independent, free thinker, Dr. Bob Lorinser.
Dr. Lorinser and I worked for over 20 years as attending physicians together treating critically ill patients at our regional hospital here in Marquette. He was a doc who was always the patients advocate, possessed great diagnostic ability, and always kept himself up to date with the latest medical science. Indeed, a role model for other physicians.
During my career as an emergency physician, I noticed especially on those ragged, edgy, overwhelming nights when our ER was in crisis mode, how Dr. Bob responded as an efficient, cool-headed team member leading with his heart in service to others. We also served together on multiple advisory committees providing input based on our clinical experiences to hospital administration on how to improve quality, efficiency and safety of all patient care. Dr. Lorinser courageously resisted and railed against the bureaucracy every time that it threatened the highest standards of any patient’s care. Dr. Lorinser believes as I do that the physician and patient relationship is a very private and complex sacred space created in service to the patient and ensuring the patient’s freedom of choice in medical decisions. The government’s attempt to intrude into this sacred space and remove these freedoms, is them trying to practice medicine without a license or medical education.
Dr. Bob knows the power of public health, and that an ounce of prevention can eliminate many chronic diseases, the suffering that these cause, as well as heading off a huge and growing disease care expense for our country. These are the reasons you should also vote for Bob Lorinser for Congress.
SCOTT EMERSONMarquette

Ours is one of the swing districts that will decide whether we hold our Democratic majority or the GOP and right-wing extremists flip the House red. If we lose here, we hand Kevin McCarthy the Speaker's gavel. It's safe to say the stakes have never been higher. And there's no more time- ballots are mailed out next week! We have to be running at full steam to lock in as many of these voters as possible. Unfortunately, the Republican attack ads against us are also running at maximum overdrive. I need your grassroots support right now to keep our ads on the air and fight back -- because every single vote matters. Polls show us tied 38% to 38% with our extreme MAGA opponent, Tom Patti, with 21% of voters still undecided. That's a ton of swing voters to reach in a short amount of time! [_**Please rush in another generous donation of $35, $50 or $100 to our campaign today. This is my biggest end-of-quarter deadline before Election Day. Please make it count by getting us to our $50,000 goal by Friday.**_](https://act.myngp.com/el/UnmyAJ3ykhIFV_7O4JVcHBnGe8sdh70ecRHeUNEbB0s=/UmlVSVlBLIYQfDM9TlPACf--vRMuiseQrvOKldRqMmg=?refcode=E18550-20220928-LongEmail-SL-DeadlineEOM-RegTemplate-NA-NA&amount=25) When I say, "The stakes have never been higher," I'm not just talking about the stakes for our race. I'm talking about the state of our country. **If Tom Patti wins he 'll become California's version of Marjorie Taylor Greene. The last thing we need is for our wonderful state to be known for sending an extremist like that to Congress. It's bad for our democracy and it's incredibly detrimental to my community.** We can't let that happen -- and our grassroots team is working around the clock to ensure that it doesn't. Our neighbor-to-neighbor volunteer program is ramping up quickly and last weekend we knocked on thousands of doors (this year's record!). body:
#
Hey Derek, it's John.
As we race towards Election Day, I want to take you on a quick walk down memory lane by looking at some important dates from your supporter record...
**February 08, 2021 🥳**
The day we launched our historic campaign to flip this U.S. Senate seat. When I saw all of your support pouring in on that very first day, I knew we’d be a record-breaking team.
**January 19, 2021 📧**
This is a *huge* day in history, Derek. Don’t remember why? It’s the day you subscribed to our email list! Supporters like you who open and engage with emails like this one are a huge help for our campaign.
**September 30, 2022 🚨**
TGIFriday... AKA the last day of the quarter. This marks an *extremely* important deadline for our campaign and is the very last EOQ deadline before Election Day.
**November 08, 2022 🗳️**
We’ve been counting down this day for over a year now. It’s Election Day and it’s less than 40 days out.
**September 28, 2022 📅**
That brings us to today (or yesterday, if you’re like me + not great at keeping up on your inbox 😬). And I have something important to ask you...
**[With just two days until our important FEC deadline, I would absolutely be honored if you made your first donation today. What do you say, Derek? Can you chip in $5 right now?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220928-2?amount=5&refcode=em20220928-7432&refcode2=7432_434096_WTJRZz&akid=7432%2E434096%2EWTJRZz)**

Thank you for being a part of this team. This campaign wouldn’t be possible without you.
—John ❤️
John Fetterman
Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania
Democratic Nominee for U.S. Senate

body:
[1]Charles Booker

Peter, Rand cannot
be trusted.

Rand Paul has been colluding with Rick Scott to take a chainsaw to Social
Security – a lifeline for millions of seniors and folks with disabilities.
As usual, Rand is abusing his power and punching down.

If Rand Paul finds a way to undermine Social Security, he will use it
every time – at the expense of millions of us across Kentucky and the
country.

If you care about protecting Social Security and expanding Medicare for
All, understand it is imperative we defeat Rand Paul this November. Rand
is one of the single most outspoken critics of Social Security in the
Senate and seeks to slash it at every turn.

Rand proposed budget cuts that would hurt seniors and families, even
cutting Social Security and Medicare for *current retirees.* This is not
the American Dream. This is not the American Promise. This is not Freedom.
We must do better, for our communities.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18699?refcode=em20220928-2531&t=1001&akid=2531%2E346206%2EXTcrth ]If you’re with me, I hope you can chip in $5 or anything
you can right now to support our grassroots-funded movement.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18699?refcode=em20220928-2531&t=1020&akid=2531%2E346206%2EXTcrth ]Contribute $5 →

For generations, Kentuckians have been waiting on change that doesn’t
come.

To this day, too many families can’t pay for groceries.

Too many of us can’t afford basic medication like insulin or inhalers.

Too many of us know what it means to go hungry and the fear of being one
emergency away from losing everything.

Social Security and Medicare are fundamental protections we rightfully
deserve. It is nothing but sheer cruelty to try to steal them from
millions of Americans.

Let’s be clear: Rand’s cruelty is a choice. This November, we can choose
something else. That’s why I’m running to replace Rand Paul – to be a
champion for working people across Kentucky and our nation.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18699?refcode=em20220928-2531&t=1021&akid=2531%2E346206%2EXTcrth ]Please chip in $5 or whatever you can today to our
campaign, and help me replace Rand Paul in the Senate so we can end
poverty and protect Social Security for good.

To a better future,

Charles

From: Alek Skarlatos - info@alekskarlatosforcongress.com
Date: Fri Sept 16 2022
Subject: I've been given an ultimatum
To: dpwillis67@gmail.com

Peter,

They just keep moving the ball on me; I feel like I can't get a break, and to be honest with you it's exhausting. The Republican Party big-wigs in D.C. keep hedging their bets and won't commit to sending me help because they're somehow still not sure that I'm worth the investment.

Instead of putting money into my race, they're spending millions on seats we can't win. But, as a former national guardsman, I know how to play by the rules and take orders; here is hoping you can help me meet the requirements they've set in order to barnstorm the state with money to help me secure victory.

**National Republicans want me to raise $100,000 by the end of the quarter (September 30th), and they'll make an investment in my race; if i can't, I'll be on my own till the end.**

With only 14 days to go, we’re still short about $60,000. **[If you’re in a position to give, would you make a generous contribution to my campaign today?](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=65799af469234e3f97e7632ef2b1a290&_e=sKLoLJjpnUfblZkv_dBCL0Q-6bkJ9bcqsMU3UU4M5wEMo4PrqqqQTrQhwl0BFjLZanbbvpHnJvCDS8Z4qw1GlmCBB3UBtJ76ihF6sl32eN1mmyywhiWhH5Dg4IFR4uqDZ-87ZcY3yuIImVQ9eycxAcu-7HTj9kutSLCIW1mIusPjN7todLeJmN1XoQRsIO71uniC-a4UlTp21Z7AOkFuC4afi9xNfroaG3Eq7l6SRugKL35eizcQ_YB_LRTwXHcFROO5rODAeH-5ZIJFuW2liiT-YOJFb8_EilfuVj2DG-CWH53CHoMUfyAxduKE6fAYNW5nRm0iH-MNKE7SjRoHrFhdAT-vsnPm5zkdAkQrL95RRaMvwwTu6OWcHm3FwX5rwTalnStZO1aP25ecYKL_7THMzLgpKlJhlvHXq8IGfYU%3D)**
