Whether it’s a test or not – I’m not taking any chances. While Oregon’s 4th district has been held by the same career politician since 1986, it’s ripe for the picking now that he is finally retiring.
**
[If you’re on the fence about donating to my campaign, remember this race has national implications. The outcome of my race could well determine which party controls the House next year. ](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=65799af469234e3f97e7632ef2b1a290&_e=sKLoLJjpnUfblZkv_dBCL0Q-6bkJ9bcqsMU3UU4M5wEMo4PrqqqQTrQhwl0BFjLZanbbvpHnJvCDS8Z4qw1GlmCBB3UBtJ76ihF6sl32eN1mmyywhiWhH5Dg4IFR4uqDZ-87ZcY3yuIImVQ9eycxAcu-7HTj9kutSLCIW1mIusPjN7todLeJmN1XoQRsIO71uniC-a4UlTp21Z7AOkFuC4afi9xNfroaG3Eq7l6SRugKL35eizcQ_YB_LRTwXHcFROO5rODAeH-5ZIJFuW2liiGts9OpX2KOQQ_fx_HYtVte8PZuxW66xP3Yo_H-WbrVltpeoF6dDFhXdVQVs-aNAxp22FXGcr8ZPNLnToEtiKld337Ihw8-JKrhMUzJ_zCepyvttcEiygQK_SnqUABINElewZ4dmS6rdmJZj7V6AZc%3D) **

My opponent this year is a the protegée of my opponent from 2020, meaning she supports the Green New Deal, and would most certainly join the House Progressive Caucus.

Republicans came within 554 votes in 2016 from flipping OR-4 from BLUE to RED. Please help me finish the job this time around. If I'm able to secure a sizeable investment from Republicans in D.C., I know we can overcome the barriers that kept us from winning this race two years ago.

We know we’ve asked a lot of you in the lead up to Friday’s FEC fundraising deadline, and we’ll be upfront:
#

We know we’ve asked a lot of you in the lead up to Friday’s FEC fundraising deadline, and we’ll be upfront: we’re reaching out right now to ask you to donate $3 again. BUT before we ask, you deserve to know exactly why your contribution is so important to our success and how it makes a difference.
So first up, why does an official deadline matter? Shortly after we close the books at midnight on Friday, we are required to file a report with the Federal Election Commission (FEC for short) that shows how much money we’ve raised and from whom — down to the penny.
When our report goes public, the media and our opponents will be taking a very close look. Their goal is to size up our campaign and see if we have what it takes to win. And if we show any signs of vulnerability, Republicans’ corporate super PACs could quickly dump in millions of dollars worth of dark money to try to quickly drown us out.
So how do we report the strongest number possible? That’s where these emails and your donation come in. The number one source of donations for our campaign is from messages just like this one, and those donations come from people like you pitching in whatever they can afford. No amount is too small.
With so many eyes on the numbers our campaign will have to publicly report, it’s critical that we hit our goal. So we need to ask you to make sure Cheri does not fall short:
[**Can you please make a $3 contribution to Cheri Beasley’s campaign for U.S. Senate in North Carolina? body:
Friend,

We know that Michigan is the frontline in the fight for democracy. We know the stakes are higher than ever. And now it looks like some more national Democratic organizations are taking notice, too.

secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=092722 [secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=092722]They’re jumping-in because they know how important this race is. Karamo is backed by a national network of Big Lie enthusiasts that includes Donald Trump himself. This race is getting attention from both election deniers and the pro-democracy coalition because a “Secretary of State Karamo” could be a deciding factor in the 2024 presidential results. That means her candidacy does not just represent an existential threat to elections in Michigan, but the continuation of American democracy as we know it.
But as the finance director of this campaign, I can tell you that while this added attention is appreciated, it is not enough. body:
While legislators were crafting a plan to phase out the sales tax on groceries during the 2022 legislative session, Gov. Laura Kelly was gallivanting around the state with a hatchet in hand like a knock-off Carrie Nation — all the while posing for photo ops in any grocery store that would have her.| | |
---
| | **ICYMI: Kansas House GOP Leader Says Republicans, Not Kelly, Made Food Tax Cut** **By Rep. Dan Hawkins**[ _September 28, 2022, The Wichita Eagle_](http://links.schmidtforkansas.com/u/click?_t=4eb8bd5dcca54a0b993a2eb1eb42ba73&_m=568e3ad29cd34988ad3567e43d3c959c&_e=u8inzfXfs2lBKlPObEINIzi_BQbakWyU3M4rtzfVrFoEvDAu_8wDRISnMa51J_RMe2AD70jl-LnCP2mg7OH5Ly_SuLq5rHZFy0rMAhfTVZJYDwSQ7p8pqou60ncvO7FBuFI9341yQbMX2MzOfCUIcfqP1dp4vUjzmGG9VJgr27j_64Wu5jFnL410fsHeo25RinMBYsBY3fbtInHbdXf7bQUOUGxq8UH-_cMVkcLppocwSQWO1Bn0tXVR5BvCl_ye) While legislators were crafting a plan to phase out the sales tax on groceries during the 2022 legislative session, Gov. Laura Kelly was gallivanting around the state with a hatchet in hand like a knock-off Carrie Nation — all the while posing for photo ops in any grocery store that would have her.
Despite the posing, the governor didn’t lead on this issue. She wasn’t even part of the conversation. Tax policy isn’t created with photo opportunities and political stunts, it’s created by digging into spreadsheets and details.
While Kelly was on tour this year, Republicans in the Legislature were busy leading the way to phasing out the sales tax on groceries by passing HB 2106.

This wasn’t the first time though. In 2019 Republicans passed HB 2033 that also would have phased out the sales tax on groceries.
Kelly axed it with her veto pen.
Had the governor signed the phaseout bill in 2019, the sales tax on groceries would currently be zero.

Yes, it’s true. Kelly’s veto is the reason that Kansans are still paying sales tax on groceries. It doesn’t take a cynic not to be surprised the governor would wait until the year she was up for re-election to embark on her hatchet tour and finally sign food sales tax relief.

[Click here to read the whole piece in _The_ _Wichita Eagle. _](http://links.schmidtforkansas.com/u/click?_t=4eb8bd5dcca54a0b993a2eb1eb42ba73&_m=568e3ad29cd34988ad3567e43d3c959c&_e=u8inzfXfs2lBKlPObEINIzi_BQbakWyU3M4rtzfVrFoEvDAu_8wDRISnMa51J_RMe2AD70jl-LnCP2mg7OH5Ly_SuLq5rHZFy0rMAhfTVZK_886nzE_iaIie_EJ0ETFHwyRr26GI-rMEI8yCI_7J_IG2M0T0EnWdSHsHurYa9bNaEo4kQa6U-XtitCsvNws_SQ55ECmA1ehwMalqJh-OaLPoVLe_-WGoZ6V_tZzg5O1AICiSwHoAHgW-Q7w18bfF) ###

body:
We don’t mess around with your donations.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220928-3439-header&t=1&akid=3439%2E2526796%2Eb8lHXp)
Donating to a politician can sometimes feel like throwing money into the void. **Why are they always asking? What does this representative even do all day? How can I trust them to put the funds to good use?**
We get it, and so does Alexandria. And we’re not going to leave you hanging. We can’t speak for other campaigns, but the AOC campaign is going to tackle these questions for you right now.
**1) Why are we always asking?**
Even in an off year, even in a blue state, with or without a primary opponent, our campaign is always up and running. But we’re not just spinning our wheels — we’re busting our butts in the community and organizing across the country. During the pandemic, we ran a food distribution program that lasted for over a year. We organized a Census outreach program in 2020 that helped New Yorkers keep a congressional seat. We run a Homework Helpers program that has provided over 6,000 hours of free homework assistance to students in our district. And this past year, we’ve worked with over 4,000 volunteers – from every state and Puerto Rico – on deep canvassing, phone banking, texting, organizing, and more.
[A huge percentage of your donations go to funding these programs, no matter where we are in the election cycle. Can you chip in $3 to keep these programs up and running?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220928-1.c-SGGV&refcode=em20220928-3439-P_FND_EOQ_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=3439%2E2526796%2Eb8lHXp)
**2) What does my representative even do all day?**
It’s no wonder political supporters often feel uneasy about where their dollars are going — most campaigns feel like total black boxes. Sure, you know we’re putting it towards the election process, but that could mean anything! So why is AOC’s campaign different?
Alexandria prioritizes sharing how she spends her time as often as she possibly can. Several times a week you can find her on Instagram and Twitter taking her followers along for a day in her life as the Congressional representative for NY-14. And what you see is what you get! There are no shady meetings with corporate donors (we have none!) or endless, meaningless press tours.
Whether it’s in D.C., at a backpack drive, a rally, a union picket, or just hanging out with her constituents at the Queens Night Market, Alexandria wants her followers to feel like they’re right there with her, participating in the community and understanding the political process.
**3) How can I trust the funds are put to good use?**
Which brings us to this final question. Alexandria understands that she works for the people. Her voters, constituents, and supporters are the ones who put her in office, and they are the ones relying on her to represent their interests. When she travels back to her district every week, gets on Instagram to ask what kinds of issues are most important to her supporters, answers questions about the political process, or even just breaks down some of the events going on in the news, she’s doing it for a reason. Engaging with her community builds trust.
[You can trust Alexandria to bring the interests of the people with her to D.C. which is why we must send her back to Congress this November. If you’re able to, will you pitch in $3 to AOC’s re-election fund today?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220928-1.c-SGGV&refcode=em20220928-3439-P_FND_EOQ_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=3439%2E2526796%2Eb8lHXp)

Thank you for trusting us, and as always, thank you for your continued support.
In solidarity,
Team AOC

body:
I was outside the World Bank yesterday.
| [](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4352?t=2&akid=13102%2E53494%2ENb0HS3) It was a simple question, friend: "Do you accept the scientific consensus that the man-made burning of fossil fuels is rapidly and dangerously warming the planet?" But David Malpass—the head of the World Bank and the man in charge of funding energy projects in developing countries across the globe—refused to answer. He said, **"I'm not a scientist."** There is simply no excuse for climate denial in 2022—and certainly not from the head of a massive financial institution. [**_I need you to sign my petition and join me in calling on President Biden to help #FireMalpass right now!_**](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4352?t=3&akid=13102%2E53494%2ENb0HS3) | [SIGN ON](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4352?t=4&akid=13102%2E53494%2ENb0HS3)
---
[](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4352?t=5&akid=13102%2E53494%2ENb0HS3)
Yesterday morning, I was pleased to join climate advocates from around the globe at the World Bank headquarters in protest of David Malpass' ridiculous non-answer.
The World Bank must be a climate leader and champion clean energy projects across the world—but under Trump-nominated Malpass' leadership, it continues to invest in fossil fuels.
**We need an ambitious, climate-focused World Bank—not David Malpass and his ridiculous denial of climate reality.[_Sign my petition to President Biden right now, and let's #FireMalpass!_](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4352?t=6&akid=13102%2E53494%2ENb0HS3)**
[FIRE MALPASS!](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4352?t=7&akid=13102%2E53494%2ENb0HS3)

Together,

name: Mark Kelly for Senate
subject: This isn’t easy
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
body:
We can’t afford to miss any goals in this election. It will be that close.
#

Friends —
We all know winning the most competitive U.S. Senate race in the country won’t be easy. There’s a lot of travel, events, time spent on the phone and on video calls — time away from your family.
You have to face millions and millions of dollars in ads attacking you personally.
You have to watch the former president hold multiple rallies in your state where he goes on extended rants about you, trying to convince his supporters you are a terrible person.
And you have to hope that hundreds of thousands of people you might never meet will join you, rallying behind you to help you fight back.
All for a race that will probably come down to a few thousand votes.
But that’s exactly why every single one of those donations matters. Because this is one of the closest races in the country. And Mark does need your help — even if he can’t ask you directly or in person.

**Landsman Relies on Fellow Soft-on-Crime Politicians to Lie About His Defund the Police Record** _Landsman’s Plan Was Described in the Press as “The Definition of Defunding” the Police_ _ _**For Immediate Release** Contact: John Gomez Email: [jgomez@chabotforcongress.com](mailto:jgomez@chabotforcongress.com) CINCINNATI – Congressman Chabot’s campaign released the following statement on Greg Landsman’s latest television ad desperately trying to obscure his record on public safety by hiding behind fellow left-wing politicians who also support soft-on-crime policies. “Families in Cincinnati, Hamilton County and Warren County all deserve to be able to walk down the street in their community without fearing violent crime — and they also deserve the truth about Greg Landsman’s support for radical policies to undermine law enforcement,” said **Chabot campaign manager John Gomez**. “As homicides and violent crime were on the rise in Cincinnati, Greg Landsman voted to deny law enforcement $1 million in badly needed resources to keep communities safe and introduced a proposal that WLWT [reported](http://links.stevechabot.com/u/click?_t=8ab30ce69995407e81866ad352e10bc1&_m=422e6825b14e412a97b1033e8b133af3&_e=5UYnp04Iii6WdrxC4FbgZVzLMqn8lN3MdlqObE-PrkpCNhgJ0Z6P1gzDSl162XSIzZoRK6cfz_RgGry7lCW2jrjIk21kUVCT946luuf-6dgN8SJxTa8rvHsZ9s5_n1YlDqutMLCJNN4qQ70RydUwsIExaugoknNroljaqRJ9UgIBc2VQPCkX8UunCtBd8mmDdu5Rg52nN22HtneQ3Z_3Hm6Gta_RIXhJF6uhQ_3Km1cvXkwexOmzqUCv9h7OIdY2XEdQGlKRB9hnyiWqXlQHDJVLl77hWs5fgCoj5q1958cHBD9FrQDhB_32wdNeyT94) constituted ‘the definition of defunding’ the police.” “Now, as he faces accountability for undermining law enforcement and putting our communities at risk for greater violent crime, Landsman is relying on his fellow soft-on-crime politicians to lie about his record,” Gomez continued. “Landsman’s is trying to obscure the truth about his record by hiding behind fellow politicians who’ve also supported soft-on-crime policies and accepted endorsements from organizations that support defunding the police.” “The simple truth is Greg Landsman can’t hide from his record and can’t deceive First District voters by hiding behind fellow soft-on-crime politicians,” Gomez added. “Keeping families safe and cracking down on violent crime in our region starts with voting to stop Greg Landsman’s campaign for Congress.” “The men and women of law enforcement put their lives on the line to keep our communities safe,” said **Cincinnati Fraternal Order of Police President Dan Hils**. “When Cincinnati faced rising crime, Greg Landsman sided with left-wing radicals and introduced a plan to defund the local police. body:
Ted Budd is a gun store owner who has put his own profit over commonsense gun safety legislation that can save lives.
#

Friends -
Speaking still isn't easy for me, but I have something important to say and ask of you today.
We have watched, time and time again, as people say that gun violence is inevitable, that there’s nothing we can do to stop it. But we all know that is not true.
There are solutions to end our gun violence crisis. But too many politicians are bought and paid for by the NRA and the corporate gun lobby. In exchange for campaign cash, they do everything in their power to block our efforts to save lives.
Right now, the gun lobby is trying to do that again in North Carolina’s Senate race. They see the opportunity to elect Ted Budd to the U.S. Senate. He’s a gun store owner who has put his own profit over commonsense gun safety legislation that can save lives, and we cannot let them win.
We need to defeat gun lobby candidate Ted Budd and elect Cheri Beasley. She will be a voice for us in the Senate and will not hesitate to stand up to the corporate gun lobby and cast the decisive vote on commonsense legislation that can save lives.

Folks, We’ve wrapped up our Hoosier Promise Tour! This was our **NINTH** statewide effort to highlight the brighter future Democrats will create for the Hoosier State once elected to office on Election Day. We held **17 stops** in counties large and small — _from Lake and Vanderburgh to Steuben and Scott counties._ ****
******Indiana has brighter days ahead, and it’s because Democrats are working to solve the kitchen-table issues most important to Hoosier families and workers and seniors. ** From creating good-paying jobs, expanding broadband, lowering prescription drug costs, repealing the diaper tax, expanding health care for veterans, implementing new gun safety measures, and making the largest investment to fight climate change in our nation’s history, Democrats are delivering a better future for Indiana – _**and we’re not slowing down anytime soon.**_ Democrats want to restore a woman’s right to choose and protect birth control, eliminate textbook fees for students, repeal the tampon tax, and legalize cannabis. **We’re ready to get to work, but it’ll take electing more Democrats up-and-down the ticket to get this done.** As for the Indiana Republican Party, they have made abortion against the law, passed reckless permitless carry, put politics at the center of Indiana’s once-prized education system, and nominated candidates unfit for public office. Under the Indiana GOP, the state is in a race to the bottom with an F-rated quality of life, D- rated workforce, and C- rated education system, and Indiana has the third-worst maternal mortality rate in the nation. **A vote for Democrats on November 8 is a vote to reverse the harm done by Republicans’ extremist agenda, and Democrats are ready to answer the call this fall. _Jen Jordan needs your help to win this year's election for Georgia Attorney General. Her opponent is part of the GOP machine that has helped engineer a series of court decisions that have restricted our rights, made our communities less safe, and inhibited our efforts to protect the environment.[**If you can, please donate $10 before Jen's public fundraising deadline on Friday →**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51544984/369658742/1460579386?refcode=EM_FR_220928EPA_EOQ_TJ_FULL_8_G_N_L1&fn=&ln=&em=dpwillis67@gmail.com&add1=&ci=Cresco&st=PA&pc=18326&oc=&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDAzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMjcwZTY2MC04MzNmLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgzMmU0Y2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8M01K_4O687vTqGt6I07y50B31ZmxHwslov9YU-yqyU=)_
* * *
We were heartened that Congress finally passed major climate legislation this summer. But we still have a long way to go in the fight to protect our planet — and we face some major barriers that Republican Attorneys General (like our opponent, Chris Carr) are responsible for.

Shortly after overturning _Roe v. Wade_ this past summer, the Supreme Court issued yet another devastating decision for our country: it severely limited the ability of the EPA to regulate the harmful emissions that are causing climate change and putting our most vulnerable communities at risk.

Right before this decision, The New York Times reported on the years-long effort by Republicans to weaken environmental laws and protect polluters. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51544985/369658743/1460579386?refcode=EM_FR_220928EPA_EOQ_TJ_FULL_8_G_N_P1&fn=&ln=&em=dpwillis67@gmail.com&add1=&ci=Cresco&st=PA&pc=18326&oc=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDAzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMjcwZTY2MC04MzNmLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgzMmU0Y2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8M01K_4O687vTqGt6I07y50B31ZmxHwslov9YU-yqyU=) Not only have Republicans made sure to appoint highly partisan judges — they've also invested heavily in electing Attorneys General who will bring cases against the regulations that their corporate allies oppose.

body:
Conversations with our friends, neighbors, and loved ones are the most powerful tool we have in politics, and at Saturday’s virtual Postcard Party, we’ll help you use it. | | | Peter, With just 41 days until Election Day, we’re working hard to make sure every voter in Pennsylvania hears John Fetterman’s message for a country that works for the many, not the few — and knows how they can make their voices heard at the ballot box. **By joining a virtual Postcard Party this Saturday, October 1 at 12 PM, you can make a major impact in just one hour.** We’ll walk you through how to find the registered voters in your life and send them a postcard (with your picture!) showing your support for John Fetterman — all using our easy app. Can you make it? **[Click here to RSVP for a WFP Postcard Party, and we’ll send you the link to join.](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/atcYNHk4Eh2YdGnwBh-YDN_AKdF4M0u5pGQ87M_sP-cGYGWrDFVb05z_d7bYwkuq2vqWeJT5nTnsv2qCjffM58FGIta440we7sqUwr-aZztyPFgw6AZtZng2BVj2-zsJmFLj_PYkAso9B6_Jstgt5xi_GliSs-sRWAYAyAx4Gj3JzOtdU57XQIW4iTiOL6hGjk_rUQnOu31SQ0L7nO4HeziRIj_N8WfCKU17Bhzpl0koPFT1gl_R88NQpayRv09-n4F_d8dF6lFZKQyQGMNyBeIXcaVGzS9-tjlpgAhmeiUOTarbfRBEJNAym9JB4pwL/3pu/AWFHJMnpRRuP-hZpVFcJmg/h0/HhoydKoaPr78bG21GMDUX1tgPDmgwHceY_KkVfJlPac)** **[RSVP now](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/atcYNHk4Eh2YdGnwBh-YDN_AKdF4M0u5pGQ87M_sP-cGYGWrDFVb05z_d7bYwkuq2vqWeJT5nTnsv2qCjffM58FGIta440we7sqUwr-aZztyPFgw6AZtZng2BVj2-zsJCRH1vqJWL8MwWS70eCKO5Bz8E5DpHSR_DC8TjeTJqPHIw035XIIYu7odEvjxLdDIm6h90rzDAco1JJ0EDbGpreKWqivlAtRFWiqwsJZOQJUf5CGSdgSu-MBLwtVuPguvNGLddbsrgdgn6dalTHnw-f_T6_4pj9xLC4yQwE2pyZMezuggjpiIXpAFotwUTvsV/3pu/AWFHJMnpRRuP-hZpVFcJmg/h1/w2-dLgAIttr654ohRn3Aok7Ei3JjJZnpOKe58vMWwY4)** There is so much at stake in November’s midterm elections — including abortion access, climate action, good jobs for our communities, and high-quality affordable health care. **By electing John Fetterman, we can make sure that our state has a leader in Washington who shares our values and won’t back down.** John Fetterman is unafraid to fight for what he believes in — like his longtime support for marriage equality, single payer healthcare, and marijuana legalization. He is fiercely dedicated to making our government work for the people, not the powerful, and is prepared to take bold action like eliminating the filibuster to codify abortion rights and pass the clean_body: Conversations with our friends, neighbors, and loved ones are the most powerful tool we have in politics, and at Saturday’s virtual Postcard Party, we’ll help you use it. | | | Peter, With just 41 days until Election Day, we’re working hard to make sure every voter in Pennsylvania hears John Fetterman’s message for a country that works for the many, not the few — and knows how they can make their voices heard at the ballot box. By joining a virtual Postcard Party this Saturday, October 1 at 12 PM, you can make a major impact in just one hour. We’ll walk you through how to find the registered voters in your life and send them a postcard (with your picture!) showing your support for John Fetterman — all using our easy app. Can you make it? There is so much at stake in November’s midterm elections — including abortion access, climate action, good jobs for our communities, and high-quality affordable health care. By electing John Fetterman, we can make sure that our state has a leader in Washington who shares our values and won’t back down. John Fetterman is unafraid to fight for what he believes in — like his longtime support for marriage equality, single payer healthcare, and marijuana legalization. He is fiercely dedicated to making our government work for the people, not the powerful, and is prepared to take bold action like eliminating the filibuster to codify abortion rights and pass the transformative legislation our communities need. We know he’ll be a bold voice in Congress for working families, but we need your help to secure a win in November. Conversations with our friends, neighbors, and loved ones are the most powerful tool we have in politics, and at Saturday’s virtual Postcard Party, we’ll help you use it. # **A CALL TO ACTION
FOR A DAY OF DOOR KNOCKING!**
* * *
---
| | This Saturday, October 1st, Ed’s campaign and the GOP are planning a **MAJOR** door knocking push in the Portland area. Please consider joining!

**There are only 40 days left to knock on as many doors as possible!**

We will be joined by the campaigns of local candidates Jeffrey Tounge, Dale Holman, Tammy Ryan, Sue Abercrombie and City Council candidate Aqeel Mohialdeen! We will also knock on doors in South Portland and Scarborough.

Maine GOP staff will be joining us as well. We will be going out in pairs. If you’re not the door-knocking type, you can be a driver for someone who is!

In 2022, maximizing Republican votes in Portland will be key to winning the 1st Congressional District race. Incumbent Chellie Pingree is as vulnerable as she has ever been. Her fly-over-the-district style of representing her constituents has not gone unnoticed in Maine’s largest city. **A large team of volunteers going door-to-door throughout the city will make a huge impression!**

As the Navy SEALs like to say, **“Easy Day!”**
* * *

MeetUp Location:
Westgate Shopping Center, 1390 Congress St., Portland

Times:
Please arrive around 8:45am.

We will go door-to-door from 9:00am-Noon.
We will break for lunch then continue from 1-5pm.

You can join for either the morning or afternoon shift, or both if you are a Super Volunteer!

We plan to hit Portland, South Portland &
Scarborough.

To sign up use this link: [https://gopvictory.com/me/ME01_GPDA_10122/](https://thelanderforcongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=035bf0620f01206429344ca39&id=747ed02aa4&e=f8a0a76a2b) - Or just show up!
**Thank you! Hope to see you Saturday!**

body:
Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220928_2&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220928_2&amount=28]
Team,
Elissa’s opponent is once again making headlines, this time for refusing to acknowledge the results of the 2020 election.
In a piece published in the Detroit Free Press yesterday, (you can read it here [https://www.freep.com/story/news/politics/elections/2022/09/27/elissa-slotkin-tom-barrett-7th-congressional-district/69509887007/] ) he *again* rejected the results of the 2020 election, continuing a years-long effort to cast doubt on the integrity of the democratic process.
In the article, he argues the 2020 election’s integrity is “an unknowable thing” and declined to answer when asked if he would have certified the results of the 2020 election as a member of Congress.
To make matters worse, in a separate piece, published yesterday by WXYZ (you can read it here [https://www.wxyz.com/news/democracy-2022/will-michigan-candidates-accept-the-results-of-the-2022-election-heres-what-they-said] ), he refused to comment when asked if he would accept the outcome of *this* election.
These two statements build on a long track record of election denial. The day that the election was called for President Biden, he questioned the results, saying that there was “reasonable doubt” in the outcome. He was also one of a handful of state legislators to meet President Trump in the White House to discuss options to disqualify Michigan’s slate of electors. Just two days before the riots on January 6th, he wrote a letter calling on Congress to delay counting the electoral votes and certifying the election.
Elissa is a firm believer in putting country over party. Unfortunately, her opponent has made it clear that he cannot be trusted to do the same. Given that Congress is responsible for certifying the presidential election in 2024, someone willing to put President Trump’s victory ahead of the results of our democratic elections has no business being elected.
If you want to help us hold on to Elissa’s seat, and ensure the voters of Michigan’s 7th district continue to have a representative that will protect the integrity of our elections, consider chipping in below before our September 30th end-of-quarter deadline.
